chinese: 起床啦！快來吃早飯！
english: Wake up! Come and eat breakfast.

chinese: 這樣的飯菜已經吃好久了！
english: We have been eating food like this for so long.

chinese: Ａ，不要有所抱怨，付錢給我的地主富豪，不會在乎我們如何填飽肚子！
english: Ａ, do not complain. The landlords who pay my wages could not care less how we eat.

chinese: 我不該抱怨的！我早已知道這一生注定不會榮華富貴！
english: I should not complain. I always knew this life was never meant for wealth or glory.

chinese: 我不知道該如何回答‧‧聽媽媽的話，好好的做人比什麼都重要！我等一下要到德佳古鎮，看看有沒有合適的工作，聽說那裡的有錢人比較和善‧‧
english: I do not know how to answer... Listen to your mother. Being decent matters more than anything. I am off to Dejia Old Town to look for work. They say the rich there are kinder...

chinese: 算了吧！天下的烏鴉一般黑！那些個高貴人士仗著有幾個臭錢就可以不把人當人看，去那還不是都一樣！
english: Forget it. Crows are black the world over. Those nobles think a few coins let them treat us as less than human. Going there changes nothing.

chinese: ‧‧‧做事都吃不飽了，更何況沒做事！你也已經十八歲了，這幾天媽不在家，仔細地想想看未來要做什麼？等我回來再告訴我！
english: ...We go hungry even in work, let alone without it. You are eighteen now. I will be away some days. Think hard about your future, and tell me when I return.

chinese: 我的未來有什麼好想的？反正已經沒的選擇！我只有一個問題‧為什麼我沒有爸爸？為什麼我每次一問起妳就轉過頭去暗自哭泣？這個疑問已經存在十八年了，是不是還要繼續存在著？
english: What is there to think about? I have no choice. I have one question. Why do I have no father? Why do you turn away and weep when I ask? Must it stand forever?

chinese: 你的態度令媽傷心‧‧每個人都可以離開我，每個人都可以傷害我，只有你不行！我對你的愛超過所有的人，勝過千言萬語！為什麼你不相信？
english: Your tone breaks my heart... Anyone may leave me. Anyone may hurt me. Only you may not. I love you beyond any words. Why will you not believe me?

chinese: 媽！我還記得有一天我們走在下著大雨的路上，我又問起同樣的問題，我看見您在流淚，我問您是不是在哭‧‧您笑著說只是雨水‧‧
english: Mother, I remember walking the road in the pouring rain. I asked the same question. I saw you crying... You smiled and said it was only the rain...

chinese: 媽沒哭‧‧現在真的沒哭！人生不可能十全十美，既使有某些缺憾，你也要視若無睹，還有，不要憤世忌俗，一個人的成功都是靠運氣，羨慕運氣好的人不是很愚蠢嗎？
english: I was not crying... I am truly not crying now. No life is perfect. Where it falls short, look past it. Do not turn bitter. Success is only luck. Is it foolish to envy the lucky?

chinese: 我有運氣也一樣不能成功的！不是嗎？為什麼人從哇哇墜地的那一刻就已決定了命運？為什麼我不能走我自己的路？為什麼我們的付出永遠看不到收穫？
english: Even with luck I would get nowhere. Why is a life decided the moment we are born? Why can I not walk my own road? Why do we never see a harvest from what we give?

chinese: 你為什麼會有這麼多個為什麼？你想的事情已經超過你的年紀，吃飯的時後就吃飯，去溪邊釣魚就釣魚，不要想太多！我也該走了，拜託你把自己照顧的好好的，不要讓媽擔心，答應我！
english: Where do all these questions come from? You think beyond your years. When it is time to eat, eat. Do not think so much. I must go. Take care, and do not make me worry. Promise me.

chinese: 我知道！媽您也要照顧好自己！
english: I know. Look after yourself too, mother.

chinese: Ａ，我也答應你！
english: Ａ, I promise you the same.

chinese: 嘿！嘿！我自由了！我要去孟郡城玩一玩，好主意！
english: Hey! Hey! I am free! I will go and have some fun in Mengjun City. Good idea!

chinese: 又是一個無聊的一天！
english: Another boring day.

chinese: Ａ，你的臉色好像不太好噢！媽媽不在家自己要照顧好自己！
english: Ａ, you do not look well. With your mother away you have to take care of yourself.

chinese: 謝謝大嬸的關心。
english: Thank you for worrying about me, ma'am.

chinese: 你媽媽是個大美人，她的容貌卻給自己帶來悲傷，唉！
english: Your mother is a great beauty, but her looks only ever brought her sorrow. Ah...

chinese: 為什麼我沒有父親？他到底是生還是死？就算是死了，我也該到他的墓前表達我的心意，我到底是不是我媽媽生的？
english: Why do I have no father? Is he alive or dead? Even if he is dead, I should stand at his grave and say what I feel. Am I even my mother's son?

chinese: 好了！不多說了！
english: Enough. Let us say no more.

chinese: 不好了！在你媽媽走過之後，通往殘慟谷的聯外道路因落石坍方而不能進出，這該如何是好？
english: Bad news. After your mother left, the road out to the Vale of Grief was buried by a rockslide. Nothing can get through. What are we going to do?

chinese: 大嬸別擔心！我這就去告訴村長。
english: Do not worry, ma'am. I will go and tell the village chief.

chinese: 我老了！我的人生每一天都是痛苦的旅程，我看著老天爺的臉色過活，我渡過祈求天降甘霖的日子，我走過乾旱的大地，但這些人卻令我生不如死，也許，當我的生命走到盡頭，我會帶著笑容離去！
english: I am old. Every day of my life is a painful journey. I lived at heaven's mercy, prayed for rain, crossed parched land. But these people make death kinder. Maybe I'll die smiling.

chinese: 你說的話令我很難過！
english: What you say makes me very sad.

chinese: 因為殘慟谷遭到我們的過度濫墾及濫伐，前天的一場大雨造成山崩，還好沒有危害到我們村子。
english: The Vale of Grief was stripped bare by our own clearing and logging. The heavy rain two days ago brought the hillside down. At least our village was spared.

chinese: 這個國家再也沒有魔法師了，聽說摩羅王已經剷除這些他所謂的超級恐怖份子！
english: There are no magicians left in this country. They say King Moro has wiped out every one of the men he called super-terrorists.

chinese: 我走在宣恩城的街上，寂寞地走著，我的心情沈重，卻不想逃避。
english: I walk the streets of Xuan'en City, walking alone, my heart heavy, and yet I do not want to run from it.

chinese: 麻雀飛過樹梢，白雲飄過藍天，春風輕輕吹起，一天不如一天。
english: Sparrows cross the treetops, white clouds drift over the blue sky, the spring wind rises softly, and each day is worse than the last.

chinese: 天天快樂！啦‧啦‧啦！
english: Happy every day! La... la... la!

chinese: 如果說我們不能相遇，又何必擁有今天！
english: If we were never meant to meet, why have today at all?

chinese: 明天也不一定會相遇！
english: We may not meet tomorrow either.

chinese: 我們又見面了！
english: We meet again.

chinese: 宣恩城是父母的傷心地，幼童接二連三的失蹤，唉！
english: Xuan'en City is a place of grief for parents. The little ones keep vanishing, one after another. Ah...

chinese: 失蹤的小孩都是十歲以下，到底是不是人口販子所為？
english: Every missing child is under ten. Is this the work of slavers or not?

chinese: 失蹤的孩童都已喪命，真可憐！
english: The missing children are all dead. How pitiful.

chinese: 聽說是你們鏟除窩藏在巫士廢墟的變態巫師，你們是英雄！
english: They say you wiped out the twisted sorcerers hiding in the Sorcerers' Ruins. You are heroes.

chinese: 我只是盡棉薄之力！
english: I only did what little I could.

speaker: 6C
chinese: 我這兒有你需要的藥品，儘管看，儘管挑
english: I have the medicine you need. Take a look, take your pick.

speaker: 6C
chinese: 你需要的Ｅ只有賣Ｆ
english: A fine choice. It sells for:  Ｅ - Ｆ

speaker: 6C
chinese: 你擁有的Ｅ只賣Ｆ
english: That will only fetch you this:  Ｅ - Ｆ

chinese: 我的年紀一大把就這麼個兒子，他若是有個三長兩短，我就絕後了。
english: I am old and have only this one son. If anything happens to him, my line ends with me.

chinese: 想到我兒子，我就夜不成眠，食不下嚥！
english: When I think of my son I cannot sleep at night or swallow my food.

chinese: 我最擔心的事情發生了，嗚‧嗚‧嗚！
english: The thing I feared most has happened. Sob... sob... sob!

chinese: 老來喪子，以後誰替我們兩老送終‧‧唉！
english: To lose a son in old age. Who will bury the two of us now... Ah.

chinese: 我每天求神拜佛祈求我兒子平安歸來！
english: Every day I pray to the gods and the Buddha for my son to come home safe.

chinese: 只要我兒子能出現，以後我吃素！
english: If only my son would appear, I would give up meat for the rest of my life.

chinese: 心慌意亂，肝腸寸斷‧‧
english: My mind is in turmoil, my heart torn to pieces...

chinese: 老來喪子，以後誰替我們兩老送終‧‧唉！
english: To lose a son in old age. Who will bury the two of us now... Ah.

chinese: 在片刻的靜默，相視無語！
english: A moment of silence, and neither of us has a word to say.

chinese: 多說無益！
english: There is no use talking about it.

chinese: 邪惡法師在廢墟！鐘滑旻幗載颱豌！
english: The evil sorcerer is in the ruins! %$#@*&!

chinese: 想起我孩子的一顰一笑，我就成為痛苦之王‧‧若有人將我兒帶回我身邊，我準備將珍藏已久的泊天神俑送給他。
english: When I remember every look on my child's face, I become the king of pain... If anyone brings my son back to me, I will give him the Heavenbound Effigy I have treasured for years.

chinese: 我們會留意的。
english: We will keep an eye out.

chinese: 我兒子有雙大眼睛，喜歡唱兒歌，非常的可愛活潑，等到你們以後做父母就能體會我的心情。
english: My son has big eyes and loves to sing nursery rhymes. He is so lively and sweet. When you are parents yourselves, you will understand how I feel.

chinese: 這是我兒子！以前活蹦亂跳，現在竟然動也不動‧‧天啊！嗚‧嗚‧雖然是這樣的結果，我還是謝謝你們！這是泊天神俑。
english: This is my son. He used to run and jump everywhere, and now he does not move at all... God. Sob... sob... Even so, thank you. Here is the Heavenbound Effigy.

chinese: 唉！這是人生最大的創痛！
english: Ah. This is the deepest wound a life can take.

chinese: 因為我太思念我的兒子，現已臥病在床！
english: I miss my son so much that I have taken to my bed sick.

chinese: 見到他，我的病才會好起來！
english: Only seeing him will make me well again.

chinese: 我的兒子被那些法師抓去做人體實驗，生命中為什麼總是要面對生離死別？
english: My son was taken by those sorcerers to be experimented on. Why must life always come down to parting and death?

chinese: 我很遺憾！
english: I am so sorry.

chinese: 謝謝你們帶我兒子回家，雖然是一具屍體！
english: Thank you for bringing my son home, even if only his body.

speaker: 6B
chinese: 歡迎光臨本旅店，客倌有何貴幹？
english: Welcome to our inn, sir. What can I do for you?

speaker: 6B
chinese: 哦！休息只要２０，客倌有確定嗎？
english: Oh. A room is only 20. Are you sure, sir?

speaker: 6B
chinese: 希望客倌有個好夢！
english: I hope you have good dreams, sir.

speaker: 6B
chinese: 希望客倌再度光臨本店
english: Please come again, sir.

speaker: 6B
chinese: 對不起！客倌您的錢不夠！
english: I am sorry, sir. You do not have enough money.

chinese: MStg85.ANM
MStg86.ANM
你想幹什麼？我知道你要幹什麼！
english: What do you want? I know what you want.

chinese: 請說說看！
english: Please, tell me.

chinese: 你心中一直有個疑問：我是不是叛國者？
english: One question has never left your mind: am I a traitor to my country?

chinese: 在未來的世界裡有一位名叫華盛頓的人，他的祖國視他為叛國者，但是，歷史還他清白！並不是每個政客及革命者都能獲此殊榮
english: In a world yet to come there is a man called Washington. His own country called him a traitor, but history cleared his name. Not every politician or revolutionary earns that honor.

chinese: 擁有高貴的知識不代表既擁有權力，唯有崇高的理想與高尚的人格才能獲得歷史的正面評價！
english: Noble knowledge does not mean holding power. Only high ideals and an honorable character earn a good name from history.

chinese: 謝謝你的指教！
english: Thank you for the lesson.

chinese: 地上有四種顏色的燭臺，你必須放置在正確的位置，只要沒有做錯，你就能得到應該得到的，我該走了！
english: There are four colored candle stands on the ground. You must place them in the right positions. Get it right and you will receive what you deserve. I must go now.

chinese: 得到家書！裡面寫著：弟弟，讓持有者謁見六手甲乙佛！
english: You received a letter from home. It reads: Brother, let the bearer be granted audience with the Six-Armed Buddha of Jiayi.

speaker: 6A
chinese: 在宣恩城買武器就要找我，儘管看，儘管挑
english: If you want weapons in Xuan'en City, come to me. Take a look, take your pick.

speaker: 6A
chinese: 客人真是好眼光，Ｅ只賣Ｆ
english: A fine eye, sir. The price:  Ｅ - Ｆ

speaker: 6A
chinese: 你這Ｅ只能賣Ｆ
english: That old thing? I can offer:  Ｅ - Ｆ

chinese: MStg87.ANM
MStg88.ANM
人類毫無止境地不停的破壞造物者的奇蹟，我雖然不能預知未來，萬能的神自會做出審判。
english: Mankind tears down the Creator's miracles without end. I cannot see the future, but the almighty god will pass his judgment.

chinese: 我們在此追求心靈平靜，祈求神賜予公理正義，忘記名利財富，壞事做絕的人將得不到神的赦免，別夢想花錢就能登上天堂！
english: Here we seek peace of mind and pray for justice, forgetting fame and fortune. Those who do every evil will get no pardon from god. Do not dream that money buys a place in heaven.

chinese: 我相信理想國終會降臨，這個世界將在滅絕後獲得重生！
english: I believe the ideal kingdom will come at last. This world will be reborn after it is wiped away.

chinese: 讓我們一起祈禱新世界的到來！神將挑選祂的使徒開創新世界！
english: Let us pray together for the new world. God will choose his apostles to build it.

chinese: 肯定旁門左道的那一小撮沒人愛的巫士們正躲在潮濕的地盤，他們拿走釋聖經，寄望從神聖的教義中得到領悟，以遂行充滿邪惡的卑劣目的
english: That little band of unloved sorcerers and their crooked ways hide in some damp lair. They took the Sacred Sutra, hoping holy teachings will grant insight to serve their vile ends.

chinese: 神在召喚優秀的使徒悍衛祂的國度，你們願意成為神的使徒嗎？
english: God is calling for fine apostles to defend his kingdom. Will you become his apostles?

chinese: 我相信神！也願意成為祂的使徒！
english: I believe in god, and I am willing to be his apostle.

chinese: 去巫士廢墟拿回釋聖經，奉神之名！
english: Go to the Sorcerers' Ruins and bring back the Sacred Sutra, in god's name.

chinese: 不能欺騙神！一定要拿回釋聖經！
english: You cannot lie to god. You must bring back the Sacred Sutra.

chinese: 釋聖經又重回神的懷抱！你們不辱神的使命！
english: The Sacred Sutra has returned to god's embrace. You have honored his mission.

chinese: 你們是神的優秀使徒！
english: You are god's finest apostles.

chinese: 我不相信神！
english: I do not believe in god.

chinese: 神會懲罰不敬的人！
english: God punishes those who show no reverence.

chinese: 神的雙手會毀滅你們！
english: The hands of god will destroy you.

chinese: 狗屎！
english: Bullshit.

chinese: 術業有專攻，泡妞有絕招！
english: Every trade has its master, and chasing girls has its tricks.

chinese: 聞道有先後，泡不到別難過！
english: Some learn the way sooner, some later. If you strike out, do not take it too hard.

chinese: 一道打不開的門，它的鑰匙孔看起來很奇特！
english: A door that will not open. The keyhole looks very strange.

chinese: 我看著妳踩著甜蜜的腳步，走近我等待的身影，我好想將妳擁入懷中，緊緊的抱著‧‧我絕不讓妳離開我！
english: I watch you come toward me with those sweet little steps, toward the shape of me waiting. I want to pull you into my arms and hold you tight... I will never let you leave me.

chinese: 我最喜歡聽你的花言巧語！
english: Sweet talk is what I like best about you.

chinese: 在村的西邊就是西籬溫泉，聽說可以治療皮膚病調節全身血路，有病治病，沒病強身，有時候還可以大飽眼福。
english: West of the village is the Xili Hot Spring. They say it cures skin conditions and gets the blood moving. It heals the sick and strengthens the well, and sometimes there is quite a view.

chinese: 我媽媽說我不能唸書，只能放羊。
english: My mother says I cannot go to school. All I can do is herd the sheep.

chinese: 剛剛我看到ㄧ團黑氣竄入殘慟谷，真是壯觀！
english: I just saw a mass of black vapor rush into the Vale of Grief. What a sight!

chinese: 我相信你的誠意！
english: I believe you are sincere.

chinese: 我相信你的誠意！
english: I believe you are sincere.

chinese: 這是個供桌！兩旁的對聯寫著：心誠則靈，趕快進貢！
english: This is an offering table. The couplet on either side reads: a sincere heart works wonders. Make your offering now.

chinese: 謝謝你們放我出來‧‧我好餓啊！讓我吃了你們！
english: Thank you for letting me out... I am so hungry. Let me eat you!

chinese: 休想！
english: Not a chance.

chinese: 找到牛馬角！
english: Found the Ox-Horse Horn!

MStg89.ANM
MStg90.ANM
這個龐大發出噪音的鐵製物品是炎灼石廟的熱力來源！
english: This huge, roaring iron thing is the heat source of the Blazing Stone Temple.

chinese: 我想它再也不會發生作用了！
english: I do not think it will ever work again.

MStg104.ANM
我們是裸體姐妹花，小夥子你好帥耶，來陪我們吧！
english: We are the naked sisters. You are so handsome, boy. Come and keep us company.

MStg105.ANM
我們要玩弄你的靈魂‧‧哈‧哈‧
english: We are going to toy with your soul... ha... ha...

chinese: Ａ，你還好吧？
english: Ａ, are you all right?

chinese: 糟糕了！他一點反應都沒有。
english: This is bad. He is not responding at all.

chinese: 他的靈魂已經被攝走了！
english: His soul has been taken.

chinese: 我們快去找這兩個不要臉的女人！
english: We have to go after those two shameless women, now.

chinese: MStg107.ANM
MStg106.ANM
我感到一陣暈眩，接著我就不醒人事，當我回復過來後，你們都不在我身邊，我正在擔心你們就出現了！
english: I felt a rush of dizziness, and then I was gone. When I came round, none of you were with me. I was starting to worry, and then you appeared.

chinese: 還說呢，是我們替你擔心！
english: Listen to you. We were the ones worrying about you.

chinese: 你的魂魄被痛苦使者懾走。
english: Your soul was taken by the Envoy of Pain.

chinese: 痛苦使者被我們打倒，才救回你的魂魄！
english: We brought your soul back by striking the Envoy of Pain down.

chinese: 我沒有親手殺了他真是遺憾！
english: It is a shame I did not kill him with my own hands.

chinese: 給我潘尼羅亞茶‧‧唯有它能解我永恆的饑渴！
english: Give me Panneroia tea... only it can quench my endless thirst.

chinese: 給你潘尼羅亞茶！
english: Here is your Panneroia tea.

speaker: 6A
chinese: 謝謝你！如果你們感到徬徨無助，拿著約書亞樹枝到蘇格禮找位叫阿里的彫刻師，他會幫你們做枯萎豎笛，用枯萎豎笛枯萎此地所有的水仙花，或許對你們有所幫助！
english: Thank you. If you feel lost, take a Joshua tree branch to Sugeli and find a carver named Ali. He will make you a withering clarinet. Use it to wither every narcissus here. It may help.

chinese: 這是個有用的消息！
english: That is useful to know.

speaker: 6A
chinese: 我依然感到饑渴！
english: I am thirsty still.

chinese: 我沒有潘尼羅亞茶！
english: I do not have any Panneroia tea.

speaker: 6A
chinese: 我會繼續饑渴下去！
english: Then I will go on being thirsty.

chinese: 找到子燭！
english: Found the Child Candle!

chinese: 生活本來就是平凡的！偏偏有人非對現實不滿，知足才能常樂，像我每天餓著肚子，懷抱著感恩的心情誠實納稅，不問摩羅王做了什麼，要問我們為摩羅王做了什麼！
english: Life is plain by nature. Some just have to resent it. Contentment is happiness. I go hungry and still pay my taxes gladly. Ask not what King Moro did for us; ask what we did for him.

chinese: 與君一席話，勝讀十年書！讓我們與摩羅王攜手並進，共創美好的未來！
english: One talk with you is worth ten years of study. Let us walk hand in hand with King Moro and build a beautiful future together.

chinese: 你這個從頭賤到腳的賤骨頭！
english: You are rotten to the bone, from your head right down to your feet.

chinese: 樂天知命，面對現實就是賤骨頭？
english: So being content with my lot and facing reality makes me rotten?

chinese: 有權就會有錢！有錢就會有權！我的能力強，家世好，見人說人話，見鬼說鬼話！看在你媽媽的份上，我才跟你說這些話！
english: Power brings money and money brings power. I am able, I come from a good family, and I know what to say to anyone, man or devil. I only tell you this for your mother's sake.

chinese: 放屁！
english: What crap.

chinese: 你說什麼？
english: What did you say?

chinese: 我說村長了不起！
english: I said the village chief is magnificent.

chinese: 聽說通往殘慟谷的道路被落石封閉，希望了不起的村長想想法子！
english: They say the road to the Vale of Grief is blocked by a rockslide. I hope our magnificent village chief can think of something.

chinese: 本村只要有我，大事化小，小事化無！安啦！福氣啦！
english: As long as I am in this village, big trouble becomes small and small trouble becomes nothing. Relax. Count your blessings.

chinese: 福氣啦！
english: Count your blessings.

chinese: 我真是苦命啊！這麼年輕就獨守空閨，我先生到了哈曼奴之後，從此就音訊全無，不知死活！
english: What a bitter life I have. So young, and sleeping alone. After my husband went to Hamanu there was never another word from him. I do not know if he is alive or dead.

chinese: 我是柯特，我放棄生命擁抱音樂，而你可以放棄音樂擁抱生命！別相信搖滾樂真能改變世界‧別相信烏茲握在我的手上‧別相信腦中堆積的古柯鹼‧‧
english: I am Kurt. I gave up life to embrace music; you can give up music for life. Do not believe rock can change the world. Do not believe the Uzi in my hand, or the cocaine in my head...

chinese: MStg110.ANM
進去吧！裡面是美麗新世界‧‧沒有記憶、沒有手鎗‧‧
english: Go on in. A brave new world is waiting... no memories, no handguns...

chinese: MStg109.ANM
我是青春小鳥！請告訴我二八年華加雙十佳人等於？
english: I am the bird of youth. Tell me: the bloom of sixteen plus a beauty of twenty equals what?

chinese: 我想是青春不在！
english: I would say youth is gone.

chinese: 啾‧啾‧啾‧你錯了！
english: Cheep... cheep... cheep... wrong!

chinese: 我想是嫁不出去的老處女！
english: I would say an old maid nobody will marry.

chinese: 啾‧啾‧啾‧你錯了！
english: Cheep... cheep... cheep... wrong!

chinese: 難道是熱情如火只求歡樂無限的狼虎之年！
english: Could it be the wolf-and-tiger years, all fire and hunger and endless pleasure?

chinese: 啾‧啾‧啾‧精力充沛的青春小鳥告訴你：答對了！我要送給你克勞蒂香水。
english: Cheep... cheep... cheep... the tireless bird of youth tells you: correct! I will give you Claudie perfume.

chinese: 啾‧啾‧啾‧我是精力充沛一洩千里的青春小鳥！
english: Cheep... cheep... cheep... I am the bird of youth, and I never run out of steam!

speaker: 6C
chinese: 我是個走在時代尖端的女姓，流行、隨便‧不！是隨性‧開放、塑身整型以及參加走入男廁運動全搞遍
english: I am a woman at the cutting edge. Fashionable, easy... no! Free-spirited. Open-minded, body-sculpted, and I have marched into the men's room for the cause too.

speaker: 6C
chinese: 這位小姐，我們不要做男人的奴隸要做最佳女主角，給我克勞蒂香水，這是我男朋友最喜歡的味道！
english: Miss, we will not be slaves to men. We will be the leading ladies. Give me Claudie perfume. It is my boyfriend's favorite scent.

chinese: 就讓這瓶香水灑滿妳全身，讓妳的男朋友聞到天荒地老！
english: Let this bottle cover you from head to toe, so your boyfriend can smell it till the end of time.

speaker: 6C
chinese: 謝謝你的祝福！
english: Thank you for the blessing.

speaker: 6C
chinese: 在一個浪漫的夜晚‧‧因為你給我的香水使我與我的男友快樂似神仙！
english: On one romantic night... the perfume you gave me left me and my boyfriend as happy as gods.

chinese: 不！我們不要做男人的奴隸，要做最佳女主角！
english: No. We will not be slaves to men. We will be the leading ladies.

speaker: 6C
chinese: 你所說的不正是我說的！這是絢麗面具，因為你給我一個值得深思的回答！我為你打開溝通之門，我的男友就在裡面！
english: That is exactly what I said. Here is the Dazzling Mask, for giving me an answer worth thinking about. I will open the door of communication for you. My boyfriend is inside.

speaker: 6C
chinese: 我還在深思！
english: I am still thinking about it.

speaker: 6C
chinese: 妳並沒有克勞蒂香水！
english: You do not have any Claudie perfume.

chinese: 找到玄白赤鼎！
english: Found the Tricolor Cauldron!

speaker: 6B
chinese: 這位小姐妳應該回到家中不要在外搔首弄姿，然後走入愛情的墳墓，做個沒有見識的家庭主婦！
english: Miss, you belong at home, not out here preening. Then into the grave of love with you, to be a housewife who knows nothing of the world.

speaker: 6B
chinese: 可惜的是妳想不到人生的意義，跟這堆亂臣賊子胡搞還自認替天行道，今天我要表彰你們的苦心，除了痛苦，還是痛苦！
english: Sadly you never grasped the meaning of life. You run around with this pack of traitors and call it doing heaven's work. Today I honor your efforts with pain, and more pain.

chinese: 你在說什麼啊？你不記得我了嗎？
english: What are you talking about? Do you not remember me?

speaker: 6B
chinese: 妳擁有蕩婦的氣質，帶著荒淫不屑的無恥表情，連聖母馬麗雅看了都潸然淚下！
english: You have the air of a slut, that shameless look of contempt and debauchery. The Virgin Mary herself would weep to see it.

chinese: 你到底還是不是個人啊！我們為了找回你的靈魂費盡心血‧‧你竟然滿嘴胡言亂語！
english: Are you even human anymore? We poured everything into getting your soul back... and all you can do is spout nonsense.

chinese: 我跟你的交情到此為止！
english: Whatever we were to each other ends here.

speaker: 6B
chinese: 我不是人！我是神！現在，將由最天真無邪身材惹火浪漫性感我的紅粉知己高潮雙姝教你們做人的大道理！
english: I am not human. I am a god. Now my innocent, hot-bodied, romantic little companions, the Twin Sisters of Ecstasy, will teach you how to be human.

chinese: 大家一起上！
english: Everyone, at him!

chinese: MonB9A.ANM
MB11A.ANM
MB11D.ANM
換我來陪你們玩玩！
english: My turn to play with you.

speaker: 6D
chinese: 此刻你的心情複雜，極不欲接受眼前的事實
english: Your heart is in turmoil. You do not want to accept what is in front of you.

speaker: 6D
chinese: 只要你們交出身上所有的物品，那麼你們的好朋友將重回這亂七八糟的世界！如何？
english: Hand over everything you are carrying and your dear friend comes back to this filthy world. How about it?

chinese: 你是屠殺泰吉拉村民的兇手！沒什麼好談的！
english: You are the one who slaughtered the villagers of Tajira. There is nothing to discuss.

speaker: 6D
chinese: 何不用愛包容所有的仇恨？
english: Why not let love swallow up all that hatred?

chinese: 你沒資格談愛！
english: You have no right to talk about love.

speaker: 6D
chinese: 妳也不配說愛！你們以為我不了解聖光島的秘密‧‧難道權力真的那麼引人暇思？沒錯！友情不過是一件破衣
english: Neither do you. You think I do not know the secret of Holy Island... Is power really so alluring? You are right. Friendship is nothing but a rag.

speaker: 6D
chinese: 權力才是華服！我為你的朋友感到難過，所以我決定自己動手，順便教訓你們這些無情無義的雜碎！
english: Power is the fine robe. I feel sorry for your friend, so I will do this myself, and teach you heartless scum a lesson while I am at it.

chinese: 這位怪人，你誤會了！殺了你才是天底下最有趣的事情。
english: You have it wrong, freak. Killing you is the most fun a person can have.

speaker: 6D
chinese: 看你們肚破腸流是我的樂趣，當你們的腦漿濺滿我的臉上歡喜的淚水佈滿我的雙眼，鮮血從一片模糊的軀體蜂湧而出
english: My joy is watching your guts spill out, your brains splash across my face, tears of delight filling my eyes, blood pouring from a body torn past recognition.

speaker: 6D
chinese: 我的雙手緊握你們活蹦亂跳的心臟，這是極致的美感，生命不過如此‧‧對你們來說是毀滅，對我來說是天堂！
english: My hands closing around your still-beating hearts. That is beauty at its purest. Life is nothing more than this... For you it is ruin. For me it is heaven.

chinese: 你滿腦子灰暗思想！你是不是小時候在你母親懷裡待的時間不夠久？
english: Your head is full of the blackest thoughts. Did your mother not hold you long enough as a child?

speaker: 6D
chinese: 下地獄吧！
english: Go to hell!

speaker: 6D
chinese: 我擁有永生不滅的生命！我不過是暫時離開，別高興的太早！
english: My life is eternal. I am only leaving for a while. Do not celebrate yet.

chinese: 又讓他跑了‧‧
english: He got away again...

chinese: 也許我們應該交出身上的所有物品‧‧
english: Maybe we should hand over everything we are carrying...

chinese: 現在該怎麼辦？
english: What do we do now?

chinese: 我們回石碑幽徑去看看！
english: Let us go back to the Stele Path and take a look.

chinese: 這裡有糢糊卻尚可辨認的文字：左‧扇、‧花扇、釋聖‧、九‧乾坤‧‧奔‧族‧‧打開‧龍‧蹟。
english: There is writing here, blurred but still readable: left... fan, ... flower fan, Sacred Sut..., nine... heaven and earth... run... clan... open... dragon... trace.

chinese: 如果你們是來謁見六手甲乙佛的話，不但要有顆虔誠的心以及我哥哥的推薦信，你們有嗎？
english: If you have come to seek audience with the Six-Armed Buddha of Jiayi, you need a devout heart and my brother's letter of recommendation. Do you have them?

chinese: 我有！
english: I do.

chinese: 六手甲乙佛是聖光島的指引者！你們必需備齊蓮花若木、雲雷風鼓、斑瀾文簡、玄白赤鼎、泊天神俑、未見箴圖、這六樣關鍵物品呈獻給祂，聖光島就會昇起
english: Bring the Six-Armed Buddha of Jiayi the Lotus Ruo-Tree, Cloud-Thunder Drum, Resplendent Slips, Tricolor Cauldron, Heavenbound Effigy, Unseen Admonition.

chinese: 只有一樣也可以，但是當你們登上聖光島後會如何就不可知了！
english: One alone will do, but what happens once you set foot on Holy Island is anyone's guess.

chinese: 謝謝你的指點！
english: Thank you for the guidance.

chinese: 我為你們打開這扇門！
english: I will open this door for you.

chinese: 我沒有再說話的必要。
english: I have nothing more to say.

chinese: 我沒有！
english: I do not.

chinese: 沒有就滾！
english: Then get out.

chinese: 這是你們為我所做的奉獻！
english: This is the offering you have made to me.

chinese: Stage04.FTC
滾到那個寸草不生的孤島吧！
english: Off you go to that barren little island.

chinese: 我不想數到三，事實上我連一都不想數！把你們的信仰交給神，把你們的狗命交給命運，把你們的東西交給我！
english: I will not count to three. In fact I will not count to one. Give your faith to god, give your worthless lives to fate, and give your belongings to me.

chinese: 你們為我做的奉獻我並不滿意，我要的是蓮花若木、斑瀾文簡、雲雷風鼓、玄白赤鼎、未見箴圖、泊天神俑？
english: You have not satisfied me. I want the Lotus Ruo-Tree, Resplendent Slips, Cloud-Thunder Drum, Tricolor Cauldron, Unseen Admonition, Heavenbound Effigy.

chinese: 找到烈燄服！
english: Found the Blazing Flame Robe!

speaker: 6A
chinese: 是否要搭船回到石斑港？
english: Do you want to take the boat back to Shiban Harbor?

chinese: 救命啊！我是休斯王子，趕快拉我上來，我是下任王位的繼承者，為了摩羅王朝的長治久安，我不能死在這裡，看什麼！快拉我上去！
english: Help! I am Prince Sius. Pull me up, quickly. I am the next heir to the throne. The Moro Dynasty needs me. I cannot die here. What are you staring at? Pull me up!

chinese: MStg113.ANM
王子你別擔心！我馬上救你上來！
english: Do not worry, my prince. I will have you out at once.

chinese: 你們真是摩羅王的優秀子民，我也要謝謝我那兩位死去的隨從，因為我踩著他們的屍體，才能使我支持一段時間，這是火種，你們就收下吧！能活著的感覺真好‧‧
english: You are fine subjects of King Moro. I must thank my two dead attendants too. Standing on their bodies kept me up long enough. Take this fire-starter. It feels so good to be alive...

chinese: MStg114.ANM
王子閣下！沒有你世界會更好！
english: Your highness. The world would be better without you.

chinese: 你這個大膽賤民我要殺光你們全家！你給我聽清楚了，我是國王的兒子休斯！
english: You insolent peasant, I will have your whole family killed. Listen well: I am Sius, son of the king.

chinese: 我不會計較你臨終前的哀嚎！
english: I will not hold your dying screams against you.

speaker: 6B
chinese: 我從來不期待任何的好事會發生在我的身上，但是，都發生了！當我開始追逐我的願望，卻事與願違！幸運之神躲在黑暗中
english: I never expected anything good to happen to me, and yet it all did. But the moment I started chasing what I wanted, everything went wrong. The god of luck hides in the dark.

speaker: 6B
chinese: 我看不見他的微笑，感受不到他的關懷，他不願照亮我的道路，嘿！嘿！無所謂！一切靠自己！
english: I cannot see him smile. I cannot feel him care. He will not light my road. Hey. Hey. It does not matter. I rely on myself.

chinese: 你為什麼會被關在這裡？
english: Why were you locked up in here?

speaker: 6B
chinese: 我活在祈禱中，等著有一天能出來！乾柴烈火一發不可收拾！
english: I lived on prayer, waiting for the day I could get out. Dry wood meets fire and nothing can stop it.

speaker: 6B
chinese: 我總算得到幸運之神的眷顧！你們可就不一定了‧‧因為‧‧我就是惡運！
english: The god of luck has finally smiled on me. The same cannot be said for you... because I am bad luck itself.

chinese: 這是個取暖的壁爐，裡面有一堆的木頭。
english: This is a fireplace for warmth, with a pile of wood inside.

chinese: MStg121.ANM
MStg121.ANM
HolyLose.FTC
‧‧這是我母親！這個負心人是我的父親！為什麼命運要跟我開這麼大的玩笑？
english: ...That is my mother. And this faithless man is my father. Why does fate play such a cruel joke on me?

chinese: 我復仇的心願不受任何因素而改變！
english: Nothing will change my desire for revenge.

chinese: 此情此景，我實在是無法提出我的見解！
english: Faced with this, I cannot offer any opinion at all.

chinese: 我也是！
english: Nor can I.

chinese: 唉！家門不幸‧‧
english: Ah. What a disgrace to the family...

chinese: MStg119.ANM
對妳個人而言，這是個絕望的消息！對我的國家來說，卻是新希望的開始！
english: For you personally this is news without hope. For my country it is the start of a new one.

chinese: 你能告訴我嗎？
english: Will you tell me?

chinese: 人的一生早已註定，每個人的價值都將獲得正確的評估，我不是最終結果的仲裁者，我只是為人生過程留下見證！
english: A person's whole life is settled in advance. Every man's worth will be measured correctly. I am not the judge of the final result. I only leave a witness to the process.

chinese: 我沒唸過書，我知道我是個無知的婦人，請國王能否用簡單明瞭的方式讓我了解？
english: I never went to school. I know I am an ignorant woman. Could the king put it in plain words I can understand?

english: All are equal before the law. Your birth makes it impossible to acknowledge what we were. From tomorrow you and your son leave the royal rolls. If the past hurts, do not look back.

chinese: 你想知道寂寞芳心湖的由來嗎？

speaker: 6B
chinese: 從前，有個容貌醜陋的富家女，家境雖然富裕，卻沒有男人對她有興趣，有一天，她無意間來到湖的南邊，從水中的倒影見到自己竟然擁有一張美麗的臉孔，她陷入對幻影的迷戀，不吃不喝，不忍離去，直到死去！

chinese: 聽起來有點淒美，也很愚蠢！
english: It sounds rather sad and beautiful, and also very stupid.

chinese: 不必了！
english: No thank you.

chinese: 這個國家是有錢人的天堂，窮人的地獄！
english: This country is heaven for the rich and hell for the poor.

chinese: 強者的壓迫不因弱者的痛苦而束手！
english: The strong do not stay their hand just because the weak are suffering.

speaker: 6C
chinese: 做人真的很痛苦，每天不是身體不舒服，就是心情惡劣。
english: Being alive really is painful. Every day it is either my body aching or my mood black.

chinese: 我爸爸很有錢，然後我很快樂！
english: My father is very rich, so I am very happy.

chinese: 我先生家財萬貫，卻依然得不到滿足！
english: My husband has a fortune beyond counting and still he is not satisfied.

chinese: 他到底還有什麼不滿足的？
english: What on earth could he still be missing?

chinese: 本村的土地幾乎都屬於大地主卡農所有，要是有人敢罵他為富不仁的話，我一定跟他翻臉！在這樣的時代裡，以他這般的身份，還能擁有一副好心腸，真是令人感動。
english: Nearly all the land here belongs to Kanon. If anyone dares call him a heartless rich man, they answer to me. In an age like this, a man of his standing with a kind heart is moving.

chinese: 他有恩於你嗎？看你隨時準備為他兩肋插刀的樣子！
english: Does he have some claim on you? You look ready to take a knife in the ribs for him.

chinese: 我是個獵人，專門獵捕大象，得到的象牙再賣給卡農，在一次打獵中我被一頭發狂的大象刺穿腹部，鮮血如洪水般湧出
english: I am a hunter. Elephants are my trade, and I sell the ivory on to Kanon. On one hunt a maddened elephant ran me through the belly and the blood came out like a flood.

chinese: 我絕望地躺在那等死，卡農正好經過，他毫不遲疑地吸吮我的傷口，沒想到血竟然止住了，而我也逃過一劫。
english: I lay there in despair waiting to die, and Kanon happened to pass by. He sucked at my wound without a moment's hesitation, and somehow the bleeding stopped. I survived.

chinese: 太神奇了吧！難道他是隻大蚊子？
english: That is incredible. Was he some kind of giant mosquito?

chinese: 我父母給我生命，而卡農救我性命，你最好不要用如此輕蔑的語氣侮辱卡農，否則我會一箭射死你！
english: My parents gave me life and Kanon saved it. You had better not insult him in that contemptuous tone, or I will put an arrow through you.

chinese: 卡農竟然是個吸血狂魔！一想到我的傷口曾受過他的嘴巴處理，我就直冒冷汗！
english: So Kanon was a blood-drinking monster all along. Every time I think of his mouth on my wound I break out in a cold sweat.

chinese: 卡農樂善好施，急公好義，雖然他的身份地位高人一等，待人依然親切，毫無架子。
english: Kanon was generous and public-spirited. His rank set him above the rest of us, but he was always warm and never put on airs.

chinese: 卡農雖然死有餘辜，但總是有點令人惋惜！
english: Kanon deserved everything he got, but it is still a little sad.

chinese: 我所獵到的動物以大象、犀牛、老虎最有價值，卡農專門收購這些獵物，如果沒有卡農，我根本不知這份工作能有什麼利益，以前我獵山豬，現在殺大象。
english: Elephants, rhinos and tigers are worth the most, and Kanon bought them all. Without him I would never have known what this work could earn. I used to hunt boar; now I kill elephants.

chinese: 卡農雖然對人血有特別的愛好，但他並沒有危害到本村居民的性命，事實證明他只吸外來客的血，況且他死了，我的財路也斷了！
english: Kanon may have had a taste for human blood, but he never took a life in this village. He only ever drank from outsiders, and now that he is dead my income is finished too.

chinese: 大哥哥我很厲害呦！我已經會鋸象牙了，我妹妹也很棒，她會割犀牛角！
english: Mister, I am really good at this. I can saw ivory already. My little sister is good too. She can cut off rhino horns.

chinese: 不！這既不厲害！也不棒！
english: No. That is not good, and it is not something to be proud of.

chinese: 我跟我妹妹再也不會傷害動物了！
english: My sister and I will never hurt an animal again.

chinese: 我們全家人都殺大象！爸爸說牠們死了，我們才有飯吃。
english: Our whole family kills elephants. Father says we only eat because they die.

chinese: 爸爸說寧可餓死，也不能再殺大象了。
english: Father says he would rather starve than kill another elephant.

chinese: 象牙是珍貴的裝飾品，是財富的象徵，地位的表現，哈曼奴的象牙，供應各地有需要的富商名流，替本鎮賺取大量的
english: Ivory is a precious ornament, a sign of wealth and a mark of standing. The ivory of Hamanu supplies rich merchants and notables everywhere, and earns this town a great deal of

chinese: 金錢，這一切都要感謝卡農，因為他偶然的巧思才使的大家了解象牙的價值，本鎮也得以脫離貧窮。
english: money. We owe it all to Kanon, whose chance idea made everyone see what ivory was worth. It lifted this town out of poverty.

chinese: 卡農有什麼偉大的巧思害的大象賠上一命？
english: And what was Kanon's great idea, the one that cost the elephants their lives?

chinese: 卡農很喜歡雕刻，有一天他經過一頭死象的旁邊，忽然靈機一動不妨用象牙代替木頭試試看，結果雕刻出來的成品晶瑩剔透，渾然天成。
english: Kanon loved to carve. One day he passed a dead elephant and it struck him to try ivory instead of wood. The finished piece came out clear and lustrous, as if it had made itself.

chinese: 後來摩羅王路過本鎮時，他把這象牙雕刻送給摩羅王，摩羅王看過之後愛不釋手，風尚就這樣形成。
english: Later, when King Moro passed through town, he gave the carving to him. King Moro could not put it down, and that was how the fashion began.

chinese: 你看看只要是他喜歡的，絕對沒好事！
english: You see? Nothing he takes a liking to ever ends well.

chinese: 他若是喜歡天上的星星，又有誰能摘的下來！
english: If he took a liking to the stars, who could pull them down for him?

chinese: 年輕人你若是不知什麼叫做沉默是金的話，我實在是替你感到憂慮。
english: Young man, if you do not know that silence is golden, then I truly fear for you.

chinese: 你們怎麼還賴在這不走？本鎮不歡迎你們！
english: Why are you still hanging around here? This town does not want you.

chinese: 我的女兒自小就愛護動物‧‧她在信中說：如果爸爸為了我的死而傷心的話，就能體會我對村民們毫無節制殺害動物的痛苦了！
english: My daughter loved animals from the time she was small... She wrote: if my death makes you grieve, father, you will understand the pain I felt at the villagers killing without limit.

chinese: 鎮長！希望你知道該如何做才能使你的女兒在九泉之下不感到遺憾！
english: Mayor. I hope you know what you must do so your daughter can rest without regret.

chinese: 嗚‧‧嗚‧‧我知道！
english: Sob... sob... I know.

chinese: 我的女兒再也不會回到我的身邊！
english: My daughter will never come back to me.

chinese: 在哈曼奴買武器就要找我，儘管看，儘管挑
english: If you want weapons in Hamanu, come to me. Take a look, take your pick.

chinese: 客人真是好眼光，Ｅ只賣Ｆ

chinese: 你有見到一個臉色蒼白，體格瘦長的男子嗎？他的蒼白令人難以忘懷！
english: Have you seen a man with a pale face and a long, thin build? You do not forget a pallor like his.

chinese: 我有見到這麼樣的一個人！
english: I have seen a man like that.

chinese: 快告訴我他人在那裡？他是我哥哥！
english: Tell me quickly, where is he? He is my brother.

chinese: 我想起來了！沒見過！
english: Now I remember. I have not.

chinese: 哈！哈！哈！你竟敢戲弄我‧‧小混蛋我不會再跟你說話了！
english: Ha! Ha! Ha! How dare you make a fool of me... I am not saying another word to you, you little wretch.

chinese: 我沒有見到這位難忘的蒼白人士！他與你是什麼關係？
english: I have not seen this unforgettable pale gentleman. What is he to you?

chinese: 他是我哥哥，是我唯一的親人，不過我們聚少離多，他是苦行僧，四處流浪尋找他所要尋找的，雖然他尚未發現，但他依然在尋找！
english: He is my brother, my only family, though we are apart far more than together. He is an ascetic monk, wandering in search of something. He has not found it, but he is looking still.

chinese: 現在換你來尋找？
english: And now it is your turn to look?

chinese: 我夢到他來到哈曼奴，夢到他死了，死於非命！我從夢中驚醒，不知道是真是假，我馬上趕到此地，無論如何我一定要找到我哥哥。
english: I dreamed he came to Hamanu, and I dreamed he died, badly. I woke in a fright, not knowing if it was true, and came straight here. Whatever it takes, I will find my brother.

chinese: 手足情深令人動容！我們會替你留意的，你放心！
english: Such love between siblings is moving. We will keep an eye out for you, do not worry.

chinese: 我哥哥不但有著令人難忘的蒼白，他身上的枯骨法器是最大的特徵。
english: Besides that unforgettable pallor, the surest sign is the withered-bone talisman he carries.

chinese: 你們有看到他嗎？
english: Have you seen him?

chinese: 這不是我哥哥的枯骨法器嗎！不要告訴我的夢是真的‧‧
english: But this is my brother's withered-bone talisman. Do not tell me the dream was true...

chinese: 卡農是個超級變態兇手，他專門吸人血！
english: Kanon is a monstrous, twisted murderer. He drinks people's blood.

chinese: 他的旅店根本就是掛羊頭賣狗肉！不過，他再也享受不到人血了！
english: That inn of his was a front from the start. Still, he will never taste human blood again.

chinese: 雖然他殺了我哥哥，可是你們也不能濫施刑罰，你們怎麼可以擅自做主！
english: He killed my brother, yes, but that doesn't give you the right to hand out punishment. How could you take the law into your own hands!

chinese: 你的意思是我們藐視摩羅王朝的法律？你知不知道殺你哥哥的兇手也是這麼說的，他家財萬貫，有身份有地位
english: You mean we're showing contempt for the laws of the Moro Dynasty? You know the man who killed your brother said the same thing. He's rich, with rank and standing

chinese: 你認為這個國家會保護誰？是他！不是那些被他搞死的小老百姓！
english: Who do you think this country will protect? Him. Not the ordinary people he has destroyed.

chinese: 既使我們的國家是非不分，身為國民的一份子也必需守法！這不是任何藉口可以掩飾的，除非你有本事推翻它。
english: Even if our country can't tell right from wrong, a citizen still has to obey the law. No excuse covers that up, unless you have the power to overthrow it.

chinese: 推翻摩羅王朝是你的理想嗎？
english: Is overthrowing the Moro Dynasty your ideal?

chinese: 在它還未垮台之前的確是我的理想！
english: Until it falls, yes, that is my ideal.

chinese: 這也是我的理想！現在有個艱難的機會，你願意與我們共同奮鬥嗎？
english: It's mine too. There is a hard chance in front of us now. Will you fight alongside us?

chinese: 我願意盡我的力量！我是Ｄ！
english: I'll give everything I have. I'm Ｄ.

chinese: 你好！我是Ａ，她是Ｂ！
english: Good to meet you. I'm Ａ, and this is Ｂ.

chinese: 很高興認識你！
english: Very glad to meet you.

chinese: 你所謂的機會是不是與最近這個世界所產生的變化有關？
english: Does this chance of yours have something to do with the changes in the world lately?

chinese: 是！
english: It does.

chinese: 我有個線索，當我前幾天經過浩劫石地的時後，突如其來的巨大震動令我印象深刻，因為並不是自然現象，似乎是某種生物所引起的！
english: I have a lead. Passing through the Ravaged Stonelands a few days ago, I felt a sudden huge tremor that stayed with me. It wasn't natural. Something alive seemed to cause it.

chinese: 我們就去浩劫石地！
english: Then we go to the Ravaged Stonelands.

chinese: 您好！卡農在這裡向兩位問後！有什麼需要小弟效勞的地方請儘管說，不要客氣！在家靠父母，出外靠朋友，四海之內皆兄弟！
english: Greetings. Kanon pays his respects to you both. Anything I can do for you, just say the word. At home you rely on your parents, away from home on friends. All men are brothers.

chinese: 你的態度實在讓人很難相信你的真誠！
english: Your manner makes it very hard to believe you're sincere.

chinese: 小姐對不起，能否請再說一遍？
english: I'm sorry, miss, would you say that again?

chinese: 她是說您的態度真誠，令人難以抗拒！
english: She said your sincerity is impossible to resist.

chinese: 能夠得到這位美麗小姐的讚美真是令我受寵若驚！
english: Praise from such a beautiful lady is more than I deserve.

chinese: 我的天啊‧‧
english: Oh my god...

chinese: 妳給我閉嘴！不‧我是說卡農先生擁有高人一等的地位，也擁有一付善良的心腸。從街頭到巷尾，有那個人不敬佩您的！
english: Shut your mouth. No... I mean that Mr Kanon holds a position above other men, and has a kind heart to match. From one end of the street to the other, who doesn't admire you?

chinese: 您過獎了，雖然本鎮大部份的土地都屬於本人所有，您大概也知道本人也是全國最大的象牙供應商
english: You flatter me. Most of the land in this town does belong to me, and you probably know I am also the largest ivory supplier in the country

chinese: 若是沒有這些辛苦的鎮民為我工作，我也不可能累積龐大的財富，所謂：取之於哈曼奴，用之於哈曼奴！
english: Without these hardworking townspeople working for me, I could never have built such a fortune. As the saying goes: taken from Hamanu, given back to Hamanu.

chinese: 佩服！佩服！聽說你有間旅店？
english: Impressive, truly. I hear you own an inn?

chinese: 我這間旅店不以營利為目的，專供過往旅客住宿之用，費用全憑個人心意，不給錢也沒關係，所以我將這間旅店取名為心意旅店。你們若是有需要，歡迎使用！
english: My inn isn't run for profit. It's for travellers passing through, and you pay whatever you feel is right, or nothing. That's why I call it the Goodwill Inn. Use it if you need it.

chinese: 太謝謝您了！
english: Thank you so much.

chinese: 我是梅亞！還記得在我小的時候黑煞沼澤是大象的樂園，那裡有取之不盡的食物，充沛的水源。
english: I'm Meia. I still remember when I was small, the Black Curse Marsh was a paradise for elephants. Endless food there, and water in plenty.

chinese: 我常常在夕陽下看著牠們龐大的身影淹沒在夜色中，如今我卻看著牠們跪倒在人類的刀箭之下，我很擔心大象將會從這個世界消失！
english: I used to watch their huge shapes sink into the dark at sunset. Now I watch them fall under human blades and arrows. I'm afraid elephants will vanish from this world.

chinese: 可是象牙為哈曼奴帶來富裕，只要是有利可圖，殺頭的生意都有人做，縱然妳有心，也無法扭轉這些人的觀念，除非切斷所有的需求。
english: But ivory made Hamanu rich. Where there's profit, people will take any risk. However much you care, you can't change how they think, unless you cut off the demand.

chinese: 你說的沒錯！我父親是鎮長，我也無法說服他，更不用提一般的老百姓了。如果不是那該死的卡農，大象也不會受到無情的屠殺！
english: You're right. My father is the mayor and I can't even persuade him, let alone ordinary people. If it weren't for that damned Kanon, the elephants wouldn't be slaughtered so cruelly.

chinese: 此地的人對卡農讚譽有加，他與一般的有錢人並不相同。
english: People here speak highly of Kanon. He isn't like other rich men.

chinese: 他的虛假形象很耐人尋味‧‧他開的那間心意旅店經常傳出一覺醒來同伴卻不見的失蹤事件，我很難相信這會與他無關。
english: His false face is worth thinking about... At that Goodwill Inn of his, guests often wake to find their companions gone. I find it hard to believe he has nothing to do with it.

chinese: 如果與他有關，他將那些人弄到那裡去了呢？他的目的又是為了什麼？
english: If he is involved, where is he taking them? And what does he want with them?

chinese: 我並不知道卡農的真正意圖‧‧可以確定的是那些人下場淒慘！
english: I don't know what Kanon really wants... What is certain is that those people met a terrible end.

chinese: 每次當我經過心意旅館的時候心頭就感到一陣涼意，這裡面一定隱藏著不為人知的秘密！聽我的忠告：最好不要投宿那間旅館。
english: Every time I pass the Goodwill Inn a chill runs through me. There is a secret hidden in there. Take my advice: don't stay the night in that inn.

chinese: 謝謝妳的建議！
english: Thank you for the warning.

chinese: 我可以知道你們要去那裡嗎？
english: May I ask where you're going?

chinese: 我也不知何去何從！
english: I don't know where we're headed myself.

chinese: 別聽他胡說！我們要去嘉露城。
english: Don't listen to his nonsense. We're going to Jialu City.

chinese: 這麼說來你們會經過黑煞沼澤‧‧傳說只要向死者獻上菇沙草，他們下輩子就可以投胎為人，你們有看到這塊墓碑吧！
english: Then you'll pass through the Black Curse Marsh... They say that if you offer gusha grass to the dead, they can be reborn as human in the next life. You see this gravestone?

chinese: 這是我為了悼念那些死去的大象而立的。聽說只是聽說‧這種神奇植物就在黑煞沼澤！
english: I put it up in mourning for the elephants that died. They say, and it's only what they say... that miraculous plant grows in the Black Curse Marsh.

chinese: 菇沙草對動物也有效嗎？
english: Does gusha grass work on animals too?

chinese: 不知道！因為我們人類的無知、貪婪與自私‧‧只要有一絲的彌補可能，我決不放棄希望！
english: I don't know. Our ignorance, our greed, our selfishness... As long as there's the slightest chance to make amends, I will never give up hope.

chinese: 如你所見‧我的雙腿不良於行，所以，你們若願意幫助我找尋菇沙草，我會準備小禮物送你們！
english: As you can see... my legs don't work well. So if you're willing to help me find gusha grass, I'll have a small gift ready for you.

chinese: 找到菇沙草沒有？雖然這只是個傳說，但我深信不疑！
english: Have you found the gusha grass? It may only be a legend, but I believe it without a doubt.

chinese: 我相信這是菇沙草，雖然你我從未見過！這是我答應的小禮物，這個我的心意請收下！
english: I believe this is gusha grass, though neither of us has ever seen it. Here is the small gift I promised. Please take it, it comes from the heart.

chinese: 謝謝你們為我所做的一切！
english: Thank you for everything you've done for me.

chinese: 我們也很同情大象的悲慘命運，我們願意幫這個忙！
english: We feel for the elephants and their bitter fate too. We're willing to help.

chinese: 麻煩你們了！
english: I'm in your debt.

chinese: 原諒我們幫不上忙！
english: Forgive us. We can't help you.

chinese: 並不是我們不願意幫妳‧‧難道做人就脫離苦海了嗎？何不尋求一個積極的方法拯救大象！
english: It isn't that we don't want to help you... Does being born human really free anyone from suffering? Why not look for a real way to save the elephants?

chinese: 我們又見面了！我知道我的語氣並不好。
english: We meet again. I know I didn't speak kindly to you.

chinese: 我了解‧‧我就算付出生命也在所不惜！
english: I understand... I would give my own life and not regret it.

chinese: 妳可千萬不要做傻事！也許事情會有轉機！
english: Don't do anything foolish. Things may still turn around.

chinese: 梅亞上吊自殺了‧‧
english: Meia has hanged herself...

chinese: 她為什麼要這麼做？如果不是你說話刺激到她，她也不會走上絕路‧‧
english: Why would she do that? If your words hadn't cut her so deeply, she would never have taken that road...

chinese: 她求死心切又怎能怪我！她的行動不方便，竟然使用這種方法結束性命‧‧由此可知她的決心！
english: She was set on dying. How is that my fault? She could barely move, and still she ended her life that way... That shows how determined she was.

speaker: 0D
chinese: 說這些又有什麼用呢？看看她身上有沒有留下些什麼！
english: What good does talking do now? See if she left anything on her.

chinese: 有一封信！我們去找鎮長！
english: There's a letter. Let's go and find the mayor.

chinese: 剛剛一道耀眼的光茫吸走我的父親及所有的村民‧‧為什麼會發生這種事情？難道是天譴嗎？
english: A blinding light just swept away my father and all the villagers... Why is this happening? Is it a punishment from heaven?

chinese: 那麼生活在黑煞沼澤的動物都可以喘口氣了！
english: Then the animals living in the Black Curse Marsh can breathe easier.

chinese: 嗚‧‧！這個代價未免太大了！
english: Ugh...! The price for that was far too high.

speaker: 0D
chinese: 這個事件告訴我們‧不要做個不見棺材不掉淚的人！
english: This tells us something. Don't be the kind of person who won't weep until they see the coffin.

chinese: 我很思念我的父親！也許這一生再也見不到他了。
english: I miss my father. Maybe I'll never see him again in this life.

chinese: 我早就懷疑他很久了，謝謝你們除掉這個人渣！
english: I suspected him a long time ago. Thank you for getting rid of that filth.

chinese: 卡農殺了很多旅客對不對？你們拿了他的骯髒錢對不對？我都聽到了‧‧你們的良知值多少錢？請告訴我！雖然他財大勢大我也要揭穿他的真面目！
english: Kanon killed a lot of travellers, didn't he? And you took his dirty money, didn't you? I heard all of it... What is your conscience worth? Tell me. Rich as he is, I'll expose him.

chinese: 既然妳嫉惡如仇剛才何不衝進去？放什麼馬後炮！
english: If you hate evil so much, why didn't you charge in just now? It's easy to talk after the fact.

chinese: 謝謝你們除掉這個人渣！但是我躲在門外聽到你們的談話‧‧你們的行為令我無言以對！
english: Thank you for getting rid of that filth. But I was outside the door and heard you talking... What you did leaves me with nothing to say.

chinese: 你們這群騙子！！
english: You pack of liars!

chinese: 你們不能殺我！你們不是法律！
english: You can't kill me. You aren't the law.

chinese: 這個國家的法律是用來對付小老百姓的，不是用來伸張正義！

english: What's justice worth? That's right, money is one thing I have... Just let me go and I'll give you ten thousand. With that you could do so much, so... please don't kill me. Spare me.

chinese: 難怪你慷慨大方，樂善好施，原來你視金錢如糞土，視鮮血如性命！誰要你的臭錢，我要你的命！
english: No wonder you were so generous, so free with charity. You treat money like dirt and blood like life itself. Nobody wants your filthy money. I want your life.
Aaah...

english: I hope the blood running out of you brings some peace to the people who died because of you.

chinese: 這不是枯骨法器嗎！

chinese: 這麼說來他哥哥已經遭到不測，我們快去告訴他！

chinese: 這個條件不錯，成交！

english: If this end today is what I deserve, your turn will come one day. Aaah...

english: We are the real people. You few are just one more life form on this planet.

chinese: 進化失敗的低等生物，等到你們知道天多高地多厚的時候，再稱自己是人也不遲！

english: I doubt you ever will.

chinese: 請問三位人類，你們到底想要怎麼樣？
english: So, you three humans, what exactly do you want?

chinese: 我們只是要帶走一些這個星球上最可怕的生物做個仔細的研究。
english: We only want to take away some of the most terrifying creatures on this planet for close study.

speaker: 0C
chinese: 你們來晚了一步！那隻大蠍子已經被我們殺死了！
english: You're too late. We already killed that giant scorpion.

chinese: 不！我是說像你這樣的生物。
english: No. I mean creatures like you.

chinese: 我們不會跟你走的！你們這些醜八怪最好不要亂來！
english: We aren't going anywhere with you. You ugly things had better not try anything.

chinese: 你們暫時還不是我們的研究對象！
english: You are not our research subjects for now.

chinese: 你們口口聲聲說自己是人，那麼你們是那裡人？也許你在你們的地方是人，但是在這塊地方，從我們眼中理解的範圍，實在無法認為你們是人！所以說你們絕對不可以帶走此地的任何一個人去做你們的實驗。
english: You call yourselves human. Human from where? Maybe where you come from. But here, as far as we can see, you are not. So you will not take anyone from this place for your experiments.

chinese: 宇宙是無限大！我們就是從那來的‧‧根據我們的觀察，這個星球上的所有生物只有你們具有獨特的殺戮創意，同類之間不但自相殘殺，非我族類也是大殺特殺！這種與其它生物間的不同習性非常值得我們研究。
english: The universe is endless. That is where we come from... Of all life here, only you have a genius for killing. You slaughter your own kind and everything else. That habit is worth study.

chinese: 可以開始行動了！
english: We can begin.

chinese: 等一下！你們的對象是誰？
english: Wait. Who are your subjects?

chinese: 就在前面不遠的村莊！

chinese: 你們的舉動形同綁架！我們不會座視不管的。
english: What you're doing is kidnapping. We won't stand by and watch.

chinese: 你們應該要把摩羅王帶走才對！
english: You should be taking King Moro instead.

chinese: 哈曼奴的村民雖然殺了很多動物‧‧可是也不能全怪罪於他們！
english: The people of Hamanu have killed a lot of animals... but you can't lay all the blame on them.

chinese: 我們的研究計劃不因任何影響而停止！
english: Nothing will stop our research programme.

chinese: 我們的進步豈是你們所能抵擋！
english: Our advancement is not something you can resist.

chinese: 走！快回哈曼奴！
english: Move. Back to Hamanu, fast.

chinese: 我終於知道什麼是人外有人，天外有天！你們真是可怕的對手！
english: Now I understand that there are always greater men, and skies beyond the sky. You are terrifying opponents.

chinese: 住在哈曼奴的人，的確是值得研究！
english: The people living in Hamanu really are worth studying.

chinese: 我們的科技超乎你們的想像！
english: Our technology is beyond anything you can imagine.

chinese: 你根本就是個正義感低落的懦夫！我真是瞎了眼了！
english: You're nothing but a coward with no sense of justice. I must have been blind.

chinese: 聽妳的口氣似乎是非常的後悔！
english: From your tone it sounds like you regret a great deal.

chinese: 我要離開！當初是你親口告訴我：消滅黑暗力量，清除邪惡根源‧‧事實上你說一套做一套！
english: I'm leaving. You told me yourself, in your own words: destroy the power of darkness, tear out the root of evil... In fact you say one thing and do another.

chinese: 妳這是婦人之仁！我不希望大象絕種，也不願哈曼奴的居民就這樣被宇宙怪人抓走‧‧但是，再可預見的未來，人類並沒有滅絕的可能！這不是最好的選擇，卻是唯一的選擇！我們因理想而結合，不能因誤會而分開！
english: That is a woman's soft heart. I do not want elephants gone, or Hamanu's people taken. But humans will not die out soon. Not the best choice, the only one. Do not let this split us.

chinese: ‧‧我們是不是應該到哈曼奴去看看？
english: ...Shouldn't we go and see how Hamanu is?

chinese: 當然！
english: Of course.

chinese: 是誰允許你們走入我的世界？我的世界不能有人類蹤影！

english: Please don't cry, ma'am. Take your time and tell me...

chinese: 我的兒子在街上玩耍只是不小心的拿石頭砸到那個混蛋，他竟然就把我的兒子吊到樹上‧‧要吊七天，現在才第二天‧‧嗚‧‧嗚‧他還這麼小，怎麼熬的下去呢！

english: Where is your son hanging?

english: Why measure your sincerity by how much time she gives you?

speaker: 7E
chinese: 不想說話，不想思考，直到世界末日‧‧
english: Don't want to talk, don't want to think, not until the world ends...

chinese: 你是曼德拉嗎？
english: Are you Mandela?

speaker: 7E
chinese: 不要問我，沒有答案，不要看我，沒有希望！
english: Don't ask me, there are no answers. Don't look at me, there is no hope.

chinese: 你一定就是曼德拉！
english: You must be Mandela.

speaker: 7E
chinese: 我是神經病！
english: I'm a madman.

speaker: 7E
chinese: 你這本書是從那來的？為什麼會在你身上？
english: Where did you get this book? Why is it in your hands?

chinese: 這本書好像治好了你的老毛病，一位老婦人在臨死之前拜託我的。
english: The book seems to have cured that old trouble of yours. An old woman asked me to bring it, just before she died.

speaker: 7E
chinese: 她是怎麼死的？難道是笨死的！
english: How did she die? Did she die of stupidity?

chinese: 不！她是被衛兵殺死的，因為她放走了得罪王子的小男孩！我已經把她給埋了！
english: No. The guards killed her, because she let go the little boy who offended the prince. I've already buried her.

speaker: 7E
chinese: 哈‧哈‧哈‧她死了！嗚‧嗚‧嗚‧她竟然死了！
english: Ha. Ha. Ha. She's dead. Boo. Hoo. Hoo. She's actually dead.

chinese: 又哭又笑，你老毛病又犯了嗎？
english: Crying and laughing at once. Is your old trouble back again?

speaker: 7E
chinese: 因為她死了，我才能看到這本書，所以我高興！因為她是我老婆，聽到她死了，所以我大哭！不過我還是高興！
english: Because she died, I get to see this book, so I'm happy. Because she was my wife, and I heard she died, so I weep. But I'm still happy.

chinese: 為什麼她死了你才能看到這本書？
english: Why could you only see this book after she died?

speaker: 7E
chinese: 你能了解對牛彈琴嗎？像我這麼一位偉大的知識份子竟然會為了階級制度的約束而娶了這個村姑，這個無知的女人除了會種田煮飯什麼都不會，看到我在讀書就出言諷刺，最後竟變本加厲，把我的書全給燒了！
english: Do you know what playing music to a cow means? A great mind like me, bound by class to marry a village girl who knew only farm and kitchen. She mocked my reading, then burned my books.

chinese: 你真的是瘋子嗎？
english: Are you really mad?

speaker: 7E
chinese: 不是！當我知道我的書被燒了之後，我知道這種日子我無法在過下去了，所以我就離開她，我無力改變這個國家的制度，所以我裝瘋賣傻，表達最深沉的抗議！
english: No. Once I knew my books were burned, I knew I couldn't live that life any longer, so I left her. I can't change this country's system, so I play the fool. It's my deepest protest.

chinese: 這本書到底在寫些什麼？你老婆為什麼沒有把這本書也給燒了？
english: What is this book about, anyway? Why didn't your wife burn this one too?

speaker: 7E
chinese: 誰能了解一個白癡的想法？我只看得懂第一頁，是這樣子寫的‧‧依靠著這本書可以聽到神的聲音！你若是有興趣的話，這本書就送給你好了！
english: Who can follow an idiot's thinking? I could only read the first page. It said... with this book you can hear the voice of god. If it interests you, take it, it's yours.

chinese: 那我就收下了！希望以後你不要再裝瘋賣傻了！
english: Then I'll take it. I hope you'll stop playing the fool from now on.

chinese: 我不喜歡看書！更何況是一本看不懂的書！
english: I don't like books. Least of all one I can't understand.

speaker: 7E
chinese: 你這個不學無術的混混！製作小組要我告訴你：帶著你萎縮的大腦滾出聖光島！
english: You ignorant thug. The development team asked me to tell you: take your shrivelled brain and get off Holy Island.

speaker: 7E
chinese: 我是個偉大的知識份子！
english: I am a great intellect.

chinese: 我兒子告訴我有位好心的老婆婆放了他，我若是遇見她一定要好好的謝謝人家。
english: My son told me a kind old woman set him free. If I ever meet her I'll thank her properly.

chinese: 有位老婆婆偷偷地放我走，我才能回到媽媽的身邊！
english: An old woman let me go in secret, and that's how I got back to my mother.

嗚‧嗚‧修斯王子是個邪惡的混蛋，我恨死他了！
english: Boo hoo... Prince Sius is an evil bastard. I hate him.

chinese: 這座木屋矗立在這條靜靜的路上，一道上鎖的木門隔絕我的好奇心！
english: This wooden house stands on the quiet road, and a locked wooden door shuts out my curiosity.

chinese: 當我踏入這陳舊紛亂的屋內，除了這盆散發出淡淡香味的翠綠植物刺激我的嗅覺之外，其它一無特殊之處！
english: Stepping into this old, disordered room, nothing stands out except a pot of green plants giving off a faint scent that catches my nose.

english: A half-round crack in this dead trunk holds a scroll, lying who knows how long. I ease open the crumbling page: Monody... Body torn, heart of iron, break the chains, see the light...

chinese: 這裡有著堆積如山的大象遺骸，空氣中迷漫著一股腐爛的氣息，四散的落葉稀稀作響，有如吟唱悲歌！
english: Elephant remains are piled up here like a mountain, and the air is thick with rot. Fallen leaves rustle all around, like the singing of a lament.

chinese: 這是你的工作？
english: This is your work?

chinese: 我殺死大象鋸下象牙，然後賣給出價收購的人，這就是我的工作。
english: I kill elephants, saw off the tusks, and sell them to whoever pays. That's my work.

chinese: 你有什麼權利決定牠們的生死？
english: What right do you have to decide whether they live or die?

chinese: 少管閒事！
english: Mind your own business.

chinese: 只要有人有需要，有人肯出錢，就算是獵人頭我也照做不誤！
english: As long as someone needs it and someone pays, I'd hunt heads just the same.

chinese: 我非教訓你不可！
english: You need to be taught a lesson.

chinese: 來啊！來試試看啊！

english: The hunter lies dead by my blade, cold in a pool of blood. A silver key on the red ground catches my eye. I pick it up and feel lost... If he deserved death, so does all Hamanu...

chinese: 哼！大象都死光你也失業了！
english: Hah. When the elephants are gone you'll be out of work too.

chinese: 請勿說教！
english: Spare me the sermon.

chinese: 我不能說‧‧他好可怕！我曾親眼見到他在我面前活生生地將一隻鴨子變成石雕‧‧他說只要我敢離開‧下場就如同這隻鴨子‧‧我該回家了！
english: I can't say... he's terrifying. I watched him turn a live duck into stone right in front of me... He said if I dared leave, I'd end up like that duck... I should go home.

chinese: 這是怎麼回事？？？
english: What is going on here???

chinese: 她似乎活在恐懼中！
english: She seems to be living in fear.

speaker: 0C
chinese: 石化是很可怕的狀況！身體的水份完全喪失，既使是救活了，剩下的也只是短暫的生命。
english: Petrification is a terrible thing. The body loses all its water, and even if you save someone, what's left is a short life.

chinese: 你為什麼不肯放過我？
english: Why won't you let me go?

chinese: 我擁有了，就不會放棄！
english: What I have, I don't give up.

chinese: 我得到什麼？你給我的只是黑暗！
english: And what have I got? All you've given me is darkness.

chinese: 我愛妳，我要無時無刻地看著妳‧‧甜心，拭去妳眼角的淚水！我對妳的真摯情感竟被視為黑暗，真是令我難過！
english: I love you, I want to look at you every moment... Sweetheart, wipe the tears from your eyes. That you call my true feeling darkness truly grieves me.

chinese: 這不是愛！你使愛蒙上陰影‧‧
english: This isn't love. You've cast a shadow over love...

chinese: 妳若是敢離開我‧‧妳將會成為一座完美無暇的藝術品！
english: If you dare leave me... you'll become a flawless work of art.

chinese: 你放了她！
english: Let her go.

chinese: 你憑什麼叫我放了我老婆？這是我的家務事用不著你們這群陌生人管閒事！你們再不滾出去的話別怪我翻臉！
english: What gives you the right to tell me to let my own wife go? This is a family matter and no business of you strangers. Get out now or don't blame me for what follows.

chinese: 你們快走‧‧聽我的話趕快走‧‧不要再來了！千萬不要再來了！
english: Go, quickly... listen to me and go... Don't come back. Whatever you do, don't come back.

chinese: 這位小姐，你的氣色告訴我‧‧噩運既將到來！不過幸虧妳遇到我，因為我的法力高強可以為妳消災解禍，妳願意嗎？
english: Miss, your complexion tells me... disaster is on its way. Luckily you've met me, for my powers are strong and I can drive the trouble off. Will you let me?

chinese: 大師請救救我！
english: Master, please save me.

chinese: 請隨我入內！其他人不得進來。
english: Come inside with me. Nobody else may enter.

chinese: 請將衣服脫掉，我在床上等著妳‧‧是我的神床！
english: Take off your clothes. I'll be waiting on the bed... my sacred bed.

chinese: 我‧我‧我一定要這麼做嗎？
english: I... I... do I really have to do this?

chinese: 對！而且要一絲不掛，不要害羞！因為我也光溜溜，這都是為了妳好。
english: Yes. And not a stitch on. Don't be shy, since I'll be bare too. It's all for your own good.

chinese: 大師，會很久嗎？
english: Master, will this take long?

chinese: 這要看我的身體狀況‧‧
english: That depends on the state of my body...

chinese: 大師‧‧你‧這‧是‧在做法嗎？好像‧是在‧做‧做‧哎呦！
english: Master... is... this... really a rite? It feels... more like... you're... ow.

chinese: 這‧這‧是不得已的‧‧我‧我‧必需‧將‧‧神水‧注入妳的體內！
english: It... it... can't be helped... I... I... have to... put the... sacred water into your body.

chinese: 他是如何為妳做法？
english: How did he perform the rite on you?

chinese: 沒‧沒‧沒有什麼！
english: No... no... nothing at all.

chinese: 生死有命，何必做法！
english: Life and death are fated. Why bother with rites?

chinese: 唉！真可惜。
english: Ah. What a shame.

chinese: 為妳消災解禍，令我沒齒難忘！
english: Driving off your misfortune is something I'll never forget.

chinese: 對不起！客倌您的錢不夠！
english: I'm sorry, sir, you don't have enough money.

chinese: 妳的婚姻似乎不怎麼美滿！
english: Your marriage doesn't seem a happy one.

chinese: 我是阿蓮，謝謝你的關心！我對未來早已不抱任何的希望‧‧日出日落又有什麼意義？
english: I'm Lian. Thank you for your concern. I gave up hope for the future long ago... What does another sunrise and sunset mean?

chinese: 他很愛妳，不是嗎？到底是什麼原因令妳如此絕望？
english: He loves you, doesn't he? What has left you so hopeless?

chinese: 那個人是下流的騙子！他用巧取豪奪的手段佔有我‧‧結婚之後我的痛苦與日俱增，他的情緒非常的不穩定，每天，我小心翼翼地看著他的臉色‧‧看錯的話，一頓毒打是免不了的！他的可惡還不僅止於此‧‧
english: That man is a filthy liar. He took me by trickery and force. After the wedding my pain grew daily. Read his face wrong and a beating follows. And there is worse...

chinese: 怎麼說？
english: How so?

chinese: 他是個算命師，藉著那張嘴騙財騙色，我也是受害者之一！但是，相形之下我比其它的受害者可憐多了，我賠上一生的幸福‧‧
english: He's a fortune teller, and with that mouth he cheats people out of money and out of their bodies. I'm one of his victims, and the most pitiful. I paid with a life's happiness...

chinese: 妳為什麼要嫁給她？現在妳何不走的遠遠的，再也不要回到這裡？
english: Why did you marry him? Why not go far away now and never come back here?

chinese: 我懷孕了！不知道該高興還是悲傷‧‧我流產了！我當然想走，這是個揮之不去的念頭！可是我不敢逃走，他曾警告過我離開他會有什麼樣的結果，他說就算妳跑到天涯海角，我照樣把妳變成石頭！我相信他做的到‧‧
english: I was pregnant. Glad or grieving, I never knew... Then I lost it. Of course I want to leave, but I daren't. He said even at the world's end he would turn me to stone.

chinese: 你不要忘記他是個騙子，這不過又是個謊言！
english: Don't forget he's a fraud. This is just one more lie.

chinese: 他有個祭堂，他的石化能力，就是從那而來，所以，這並不是謊言！雖然我並不知道那祭堂的確切地點，如果你們能找出祭堂摧毀它，我想，我就能離開他！
english: He has a shrine, and his power to petrify comes from there, so it isn't a lie. I don't know where the shrine is, but if you could find it and destroy it, I think I could leave him.

chinese: 只要我能找到，我一定將祭堂化為瓦礫！
english: If I can find it, I'll leave that shrine in rubble.

chinese: 受人之托，忠人之事！你了解嗎？
english: When a man is entrusted with something, he sees it through. You understand?

chinese: 因為你們的幫助，使我的生命重燃希望！
english: Because of your help, hope has been lit in my life again.

chinese: 嫁雞隨雞，嫁狗隨狗‧‧
english: Marry a chicken, follow the chicken. Marry a dog, follow the dog...

chinese: 謝謝你的侮辱，我的確是嫁給畜牲！
english: Thank you for the insult. I did indeed marry an animal.

chinese: 無知的女人真悲哀！
english: An ignorant woman is a sad thing.

chinese: 豔陽高照，我興奮的大叫‧‧日夜盼望的夢想成真，再也沒有比這更美好的事情，凡妮拉對我露出笑容！
english: The sun blazed down and I shouted for joy... The dream I longed for day and night came true. Nothing could be better than this. Vanilla smiled at me.

chinese: 嘉露城到處都是罪惡，生活中充斥著墮落！
english: Jialu City is full of sin from end to end, and daily life here is steeped in corruption.

chinese: 這裡沒有值得歌頌的事物，何必在此流連？
english: There's nothing here worth singing about. Why linger?

chinese: xxxxxxxxxx
english: xxxxxxxxxx

chinese: 我是癟三雄，哈‧‧哈！我有支陰影銅環，它蘊含的神力量絕對令你稱奇，不過，它附有可怕的詛咒，只要你害死一個人詛咒就會消失，犧牲一條該死的人命，卻能換得這麼有用的物品，何樂而不為？
english: I'm Xiong the Bum, ha... ha. I have a Shadow Bronze Ring, and its power will amaze you. But it carries a curse. Kill one person and the curse lifts. One life that deserves it. Why not?

chinese: 快告訴我該要怎麼做？
english: Tell me quickly, what do I have to do?

chinese: ‧‧想要獲得，就必須先付出！想當初我也是叱吒嘉露城的一條好漢，只是，好景不常在，好花不常開，自從城內竄起一個叫極惡大鼎的無賴‧‧搶我地盤，殺我兄弟，唉！我的往日雄風轉眼間成為昨日黃花‧‧‧
english: ...To gain, you must first give. Once I shook Jialu City, but good times never last. Since a lowlife called Dading the Vicious took my ground and killed my men, my glory has wilted...

chinese: 你不用在緬懷過去了！快告訴我該怎麼消除陰影銅環的詛咒？
english: Spare me the memories. Tell me how to lift the curse on the Shadow Bronze Ring.

chinese: 潛入極惡大鼎的臥房，趁他睡覺時將陰影銅環套入他的手腕，他會永遠的進入夢鄉，而我對他的怨恨就當做過往雲煙！
english: Slip into Dading the Vicious's bedroom, and while he sleeps put the Shadow Bronze Ring on his wrist. He'll sleep forever, and my hatred of him will drift away like cloud.

chinese: 幹掉他了嗎？我希望他快點死掉！
english: Have you finished him? I want him dead soon.

chinese: 我的心腹大患再也無法猖狂！他的手下都是庸才，我癟三雄向各位致上最大的敬意！現在該是招募弟兄，重整旗鼓的時候了。
english: The thorn in my side can never run wild again. His men are all useless. Xiong the Bum salutes you with the deepest respect. Now it's time to gather the brothers and rebuild.

chinese: 聽你所言，何不自己動手？
english: From the sound of it, why not do it yourself?

chinese: 我的手下全都死了，只剩下我！我親自動手豈不是自投羅網，自尋死路！
english: My men are all dead, only I'm left. If I went myself I'd be walking into the net, straight to my own death.

chinese: 狗咬狗滿嘴毛！我不會介入你的是是非非。
english: Dog biting dog, mouths full of fur. I won't get into your quarrels.

chinese: 唉！虎落平陽被犬欺。
english: Ah. A tiger on the flat is bullied by dogs.

chinese: 嘉露城的黑龜幫老大極惡大鼎懸賞兩萬圓徵求特殊工作人員，意者親洽，解困保密！
english: Dading the Vicious, boss of Jialu City's Black Turtle Gang, offers twenty thousand gold for special staff. Apply in person, troubles solved, silence guaranteed.

chinese: 癟三雄活該！以前極惡大鼎勢單力薄之時，為了求生存，曾向癟三雄提出一套有利的合作計劃，可是癟三雄非要大小通吃，結果落得今天的下場！
english: Xiong the Bum got what he deserved. Back when Dading the Vicious was weak and fighting to survive, he offered Xiong a good deal, but Xiong wanted to swallow it all. This is where it got him.

chinese: 我們大哥做人講義氣，兩肋肯插刀！
english: Our boss stands by his people. He'd take a blade in the ribs for you.

chinese: 嗚‧‧嗚！好難過！
english: Boo... hoo. It hurts so much.

chinese: 我要報仇！
english: I want revenge.

chinese: 我們大哥待人重感情，福利頂呱呱！
english: Our boss cares about his people, and the benefits are first rate.

chinese: 嗚‧‧嗚！好痛苦！
english: Boo... hoo. The pain of it.

chinese: 我要洩恨！
english: I want to make them pay.

chinese: 我們大哥辦事講效率，心狠又手辣！
english: Our boss gets things done. Hard heart, harder hands.

chinese: 嗚‧‧嗚！好傷心！
english: Boo... hoo. I'm so sad.

chinese: 我要離開這傷心地！
english: I want to leave this place of sorrow.

chinese: 我們大哥交友真四海，喝酒不囉唆！
english: Our boss makes friends everywhere, and never argues over a drink.

chinese: 嗚乎哀哉！大哥死了！
english: Alas and alack. The boss is dead.

chinese: 我一定要宰了害死我大哥的混帳！
english: I'll kill whoever did the boss in.

chinese: 心中的低語‧‧‧就在你眼前！
english: The whisper in your heart... is right in front of you.

chinese: 我是林大鼎，別人都叫我極惡大鼎！我只是普通人，不過詭計多端而已！
english: I'm Lin Dading. Everyone calls me Dading the Vicious. I'm only an ordinary man, just one with a lot of tricks.

chinese: 幸會！幸會！我也是普通人。
english: A pleasure, truly. I'm an ordinary man too.

chinese: 聽說你在應徵特殊工作人員，到底是什麼性質的工作，能使你付這麼大筆的錢？
english: I hear you're hiring special staff. What sort of work is it, that you'd pay that much money?

chinese: 我不會滿足你的好奇心！除非你決定接受這份工作，認同你所能獲得的報償。
english: I won't be satisfying your curiosity. Not unless you decide to take the job and accept what you'd be paid for it.

chinese: 你必須先滿足我的好奇心之後我才能決定是否接受這份工作！
english: You'll have to satisfy my curiosity first. Then I'll decide whether to take the job.

chinese: 竟然跟黑道談條件！滾出去！
english: Setting terms with the underworld. Get out.

chinese: 改變主意了嗎？想做這份工作了嗎？
english: Changed your mind? Ready to do the job now?

chinese: 是，請告訴我要怎麼賺這兩萬圓！
english: Yes. Tell me how I earn that twenty thousand.

chinese: 聽說我的死對頭眼中釘癟三雄，有個叫做陰影銅環的寶物，去把它給我偷來，兩萬圓就是你的。
english: I hear my sworn enemy, that thorn in my eye Xiong the Bum, has a treasure called the Shadow Bronze Ring. Go and steal it for me, and the twenty thousand is yours.

chinese: 我會想辦法弄到手！
english: I'll find a way to get hold of it.

chinese: 東西沒找到，別回來見我！
english: Don't come back to me without it.

chinese: 你這個蠢蛋，我不是告訴過你沒找到就不要回來見我！
english: You idiot, didn't I tell you not to come back to me without it?

chinese: 沒錯，這就是陰影銅環！我認為人生的痛苦就是看著喜歡的東西而無法獲得！欲望是生存的動力，我為了達到目的可以不擇手段，這是我靈魂深處的特質，我以我的特質為榮！
english: That's right, this is the Shadow Bronze Ring. The pain of life is seeing what you want and never getting it. Desire drives us. I'll use any means to my ends, and I'm proud of it.

chinese: 我不該與魔鬼打交道！
english: I shouldn't have dealt with the devil.

chinese: 你看我像是相信魔鬼的人嗎？傳說中的魔鬼享受血肉之軀，你享受我付給你的高昂報酬！
english: Do I look like a man who believes in devils? The devil in the tales enjoys flesh and blood. You enjoy the fat sum I'm paying you.

chinese: 你享受你的，我享受我的！
english: You enjoy yours, I'll enjoy mine.

chinese: 享受完了嗎？我的胃口很大，欲望無窮！
english: Finished enjoying it? My appetite is large and my desires have no end.

chinese: 你是壞人！我媽媽說不能做壞事！
english: You're a bad man. My mother says you mustn't do bad things.

chinese: 乖孩子，希望你這一生都不要做壞事！哈‧‧哈！尿床也不可以，你真他媽的幼稚！
english: Good boy. I hope you never do a bad thing your whole life. Ha... ha. No wetting the bed either. You're so damn childish.

chinese: 你行為卑鄙，天生一付爛嘴巴！
english: Your conduct is vile and you were born with a filthy mouth.

chinese: 我從死亡之谷踏著遍地鮮血尋找出口，我並不畏懼死亡，因為我是山谷中最卑鄙的混蛋！
english: I walked out of the valley of death over ground soaked in blood, looking for the way out. I don't fear death, because I'm the vilest bastard in that valley.

chinese: 卑鄙的混蛋，死亡也不會怕你！
english: A bastard as vile as you, and death won't fear you either.

chinese: 離開我的視線，不要讓我注意到你的存在，上天有好生之德！
english: Get out of my sight. Don't let me notice you exist. Heaven values life.

chinese: 我到底要不要害死他？
english: Should I kill him or not?

chinese: 反正你做惡多端，死有於辜！
english: You've done so much evil, you deserve to die anyway.

chinese: 雖然他不它是什麼好人，但是我殺了他也對不起自己的良心！
english: He may be no good man, but killing him would weigh on my own conscience.

chinese: 先生小姐歡迎光臨舞韻歌劇院！門票一張五千圓，十八歲以下禁止入內！
english: Welcome to the Rhapsody Opera House, sir, madam. A ticket is five thousand gold, and nobody under eighteen may enter.

chinese: 買了！
english: I'll buy one.

chinese: 我買不起！
english: I can't afford it.

chinese: 你喜歡什麼？
english: What do you like?

chinese: 很多！你喜歡什麼？
english: Plenty of things. What do you like?

chinese: 沒有！
english: Nothing.

chinese: 你很空虛！
english: You're very empty.

chinese: 多精緻的空虛啊！
english: What an exquisite emptiness it is.

chinese: 我朋友的小孩死了，他一點難過的樣子都沒有，我問他你為什麼不難過？他說我本來是沒有小孩的，現在不過又回到沒有的時候。
english: A friend of mine lost his child, and showed no grief at all. I asked him why he wasn't sad. He said, I had no child before, and now I've simply gone back to having none.

chinese: 這個故事不盡合理。
english: That story doesn't quite hold together.

chinese: 這不是故事，這是生活中的真人實事！沒有所求的人生是最禁的起打擊的。
english: It isn't a story, it's real life. A life that asks for nothing can take any blow.

chinese: 對不起，你的錢不夠！
english: I'm sorry, you don't have enough money.
