english: Give him the Shadow Bronze Ring?

chinese: 先生小姐歡迎光臨舞韻歌劇院！門票一張五千圓，十八歲以下禁止入內！
english: Welcome to the Rhapsody Opera House, sir, madam. A ticket is five thousand gold, and nobody under eighteen may enter.

chinese: 請進
english: Please go in

chinese: 我買不起！
english: I can't afford it.

chinese: 你喜歡什麼？
english: What do you like?

chinese: 很多！你喜歡什麼？
english: Plenty of things. What do you like?

chinese: 沒有！
english: Nothing.

chinese: 你很空虛！
english: You're very empty.

chinese: 多精緻的空虛啊！
english: What an exquisite emptiness it is.

chinese: 你絕不會知道明天會發生什麼事！來吧，盡情地放縱自己，為今天歡呼吧！
english: You'll never know what tomorrow brings. Come, let yourself go completely, and cheer for today.

chinese: 別在意星期一的憂鬱，星期二的灰暗，星期三的沮喪，星期四我的心情愉悅，星期五墜入愛河，星期六等待著星期日的到來！
english: Never mind Monday's gloom, Tuesday's grey, Wednesday's low. Thursday I'm in good spirits, Friday I fall in love, Saturday I wait for Sunday to come.

chinese: 環顧四週，低俗的品味觸目可及，肉麻當有趣的放浪笑聲四處飄璗，我美麗的母親曾告訴我：醜人多作怪！話雖然傷人，在此卻相映成趣！然而，這幅圖畫替我的感官披上彩衣。
english: Cheap taste everywhere I look, loose laughter drifting, crude passed off as fun. My mother said: ugly people make the most fuss. Cruel, but it fits here. This scene colours my senses.

chinese: 是誰在跟我說話？
english: Who's speaking to me?

chinese: 你眼前完美的傑作！
english: The perfect work of art in front of you.

chinese: 天啊！這副畫竟然會說話‧‧
english: My god. This painting is talking...

chinese: 這會不會是錯覺？
english: Could it be we're imagining it?

chinese: 不！這是你甜蜜嚮往的幻夢！我望著黃昏雲朵消失無法描繪，我付出生命做我的畫布，完美無暇是我五彩繽紛的執著，浪漫優雅舞動華麗身影，我‧‧欣然等待世界末日！
english: No. This is the sweet dream you long for. I watched dusk clouds vanish beyond painting. I gave my life to be my canvas, flawlessness my obsession. I wait gladly for the world's end.

chinese: 世界末日對你有什麼好處？
english: What good does the end of the world do you?

chinese: 舞韻歌劇院有太多的醜陋，虛偽與做作！這對我的敏銳感觸形同折磨，追求真善美的無形軀體陷入水深火熱，我要逃離這羞恥的束縛，掙脫這陰沈的枷索，但我卻無計可施。
english: The Rhapsody Opera House holds so much ugliness, falseness and pretence. To my sharp feeling it is torture. I want out of this shameful binding, this dark chain, but I have no means.

chinese: 妳恐怕已經不是人了！妳為什麼被禁錮在這幅圖畫裡？
english: I'm afraid you aren't human any more. Why are you imprisoned in this painting?

chinese: 我剛剛已經說過了！這是我用生命繪製的完美作品，當它完成之時，也是我喪命之日，我的魂魄眷戀著這幅圖畫，我要永遠陪伴著它，日復一日我終於與我的圖畫合而為一，但物換星移使我想離開了，你能幫助我嗎？
english: I said it already. This perfect work I painted with my life, and the day it was done was the day I died. My spirit clung to it until we became one. But now I want to leave. Help me?

chinese: 我願意幫助妳，但我該怎麼做？
english: I'm willing to help you, but what do I do?

chinese: 找到拯救亡靈符交給我，我會送給你一幅珍藏已久的畫冊‧‧未見箴圖做為答謝，我的希望就托付給你了！
english: Find the Soul Rescue Charm and bring it to me, and I'll give you a painting album I've long treasured... the Unseen Admonition, as my thanks. My hope rests with you.

chinese: 我能否脫離這痛苦的環境就靠你了！
english: Whether I escape this misery depends on you.

chinese: 這就是我要的拯救亡靈符，請你收下我的謝禮！
english: This is the Soul Rescue Charm I wanted. Please accept my thanks.

chinese: 敬鬼神而遠之，再見！
english: Respect ghosts and spirits, and keep your distance. Goodbye.

chinese: 我有個愛人，她令我深深地迷戀，我覺的黑暗她揮灑色彩，我感到絕望她付出希望，這是第一次我感受到愛！
english: I have a lover, and she holds me deeply. Where I felt darkness she spread colour, where I despaired she gave hope. It was the first time I felt love.

chinese: 我有個哥哥，當我徬徨無助時他從不吝惜關懷，我走在崎嶇的路上他總是在我身邊，這是第一次我感受到溫暖！
english: I have an older brother. When I was lost and helpless he never withheld his care, and when the road turned rough he was always beside me. It was the first time I felt warmth.

chinese: 我的父親是個有錢人，他穿著昂貴的大衣，給我進入財富之門的鑰匙，他告訴我：我有一大片的土地，美侖美奐的豪宅，我的臉上永遠掛著得意的笑容，我越過長廊走到屋外，將鑰匙丟的遠遠地‧‧
english: My father is a rich man in an expensive coat, and he gave me the key to wealth. He said: I have vast land, a fine mansion, a proud smile always. I walked out and threw the key away...

chinese: 你認為你眼前的畫美嗎？
english: Do you find the painting in front of you beautiful?

chinese: 強者的壓迫不因弱者的痛苦而束手！
english: The strong don't stay their hand because the weak are suffering.

speaker: 6A
chinese: 誰可以照亮我的生命？
english: Who can light up my life?

chinese: 有人說愛情是盲目的，我是個瞎子卻得不到愛情！
english: They say love is blind. I'm the blind one and love is what I can't get.

chinese: 雖然我很窮，並不覺得痛苦，因為國家已經替我安排好我的未來！我用不著胡思亂想！
english: I'm poor, but I don't feel it as suffering, because the country has already arranged my future. I have no need to think for myself.

chinese: 你想知道這個王朝嗎？
english: Do you want to know about this dynasty?

chinese: 帕伐摩羅在一次陰謀中奪取政權，他了解人民的力量是可怕的，他不希望這股力量成為妨礙到他掌控權力的禍害，因此他頒佈階級制序大憲章，聯合既得利益者壓迫貧苦百姓，在階級對立中彼此制衡，互相削弱力量。
english: Pafa Moro seized power by plot. Fearing the people's strength, he issued the Great Charter of Rank and Order, joining the privileged to grind down the poor and set class against class.

chinese: 這老頭子是罪魁，那些個高貴人士是禍首！
english: That old man is the root of the crime, and those noble gentlemen are the cause of the disaster.

chinese: 謝謝！我並不想知道。
english: No thanks. I'd rather not know.

speaker: 7C
chinese: 從我的祖父到我，身上流著同樣的血液，忍受著同樣的辛酸！我是個一身都是病的廢人，卻也逃不過命運的束縛，給我一把刀，讓我自我了斷！
english: From my grandfather down to me, the same blood, the same bitterness. I'm a broken man full of disease, and even I can't escape what fate binds me to. Give me a knife and let me end it.

chinese: 我不能這麼做！若是有更好的方法，我會幫忙的！
english: I can't do that. If there's a better way, I'll help.

chinese: 我只想填飽肚子，叫我做什麼都願意！
english: I only want a full stomach. Ask me to do anything and I'll do it.

chinese: 我很喜歡出風頭，現在的感覺真好！
english: I love being the centre of attention. This feels wonderful.

chinese: 有錢人睡臥金床，而我，站在這裡！
english: Rich men sleep in beds of gold, and I stand here.

speaker: 7D
chinese: 各位鄉親父老兄弟姐妹們，府上若是有骯髒粗重的工作沒有適當的人選可以替您分憂解勞，來找我就對了，我這裡有價格低廉體健耐操的奴隸供您使喚！
english: Neighbours, elders, brothers and sisters. If there is dirty heavy work at home and nobody to take the load off you, come to me. I have cheap, healthy, hard-wearing slaves to command.

speaker: 7D
chinese: 小兄弟！有需要奴隸嗎？那個瘦巴巴的最便宜只要三百！我剛剛看到你們兩個竊竊私語，所以算你三百，兩頭羊也可以！
english: Young man. Need a slave? That skinny one is cheapest, only three hundred. I saw you two whispering just now, so I'll make it three hundred. Two sheep will do as well.

chinese: 我買不起，也沒必要！
english: I can't afford it, and I don't need one.

speaker: 7D
chinese: 去！去！去！不要浪費我的時間！
english: Go on, get away. Don't waste my time.

chinese: 我旺盛的同情心令我無法拒絕！
english: My sympathy runs too strong to refuse.

speaker: 7C
chinese: 原來這就是你的幫助‧‧還是要我做奴隸！
english: So this is your help... you still want me for a slave.

chinese: 不！你自由了！我不需要奴隸。
english: No. You're free. I don't need a slave.

speaker: 7C
chinese: 我寧可去做乞丐，也不願做奴隸，對我來說自由的意義更尊嚴可貴‧‧我們素昧平生，你卻願意解囊相助，所以我想這個餐盒送給你留做紀念，希望你收下。
english: I'd rather beg than be a slave. Freedom has more dignity... We're strangers, and still you opened your purse for me, so take this picnic box as a keepsake. Please.

chinese: 你不是說要去做乞丐嗎？餐盒你留著用吧！
english: Didn't you say you were going to beg? Keep the box and use it yourself.

speaker: 7C
chinese: 裡面有雞腿、酒及美女圖！這是奴隸販子給的，它比不過自由！
english: There's a chicken leg inside, and wine, and a picture of a beautiful woman. The slaver gave it to me. It's worth nothing next to freedom.

chinese: 那我就收下了！
english: Then I'll take it.

chinese: 你的好意我心領了。
english: I'll accept the thought behind it, that's enough.

speaker: 7C
chinese: 我會永遠記的你的恩德！
english: I'll remember your kindness always.

chinese: 聽說在城的西邊樹林裡，可以聽到神的聲音，卻沒有人找的到那處地方。
english: They say you can hear the voice of god in the woods west of the city, but nobody has ever found the place.

chinese: 想聽一件無聊事嗎？
english: Want to hear something dull?

chinese: 還記得那天奴隸販子帶了一名非常美麗的女子來此販賣，他只接受叫價最高的買主，碰巧修斯王子正好經過，對於她的容貌驚為天人，不但替她贖身，還給她一筆錢回鄉過日子。
english: I remember the day a slaver brought a beautiful woman here to sell to the highest bidder. Prince Sius passed by, struck by her beauty, bought her freedom and gave her money to go home.

chinese: 修斯王子是個好人嗎？
english: Is Prince Sius a good man?

chinese: 你說呢？
english: You tell me.

chinese: 如果你愛某人就讓她自由吧！
english: If you love someone, set her free.

chinese: 我想不必了！
english: I don't think I need to.

chinese: 兩頭羊就可以換一個奴隸，對我來說真是便宜！
english: Two sheep buys one slave. That's cheap, as far as I'm concerned.

chinese: 一個人可以換兩頭羊，對羊來說實在是太便宜！
english: One person for two sheep. That's far too cheap, as far as the sheep are concerned.

chinese: 你是在告訴我要愛護動物？
english: Are you telling me to be kind to animals?

speaker: 6E
chinese: 城內就數我這兒的東西最齊全，儘管看，儘管挑
english: Nobody in the city has a fuller stock than mine. Look all you like, take your pick

speaker: 6E
chinese: 客人真是好眼光，Ｅ只賣Ｆ
english: A fine eye, sir. The price:  Ｅ - Ｆ

speaker: 6E
chinese: 你這Ｅ只能賣Ｆ
english: That of yours can only fetch:  Ｅ - Ｆ

chinese: 這兒的東西最齊全，儘管看，儘管挑
english: The fullest stock anywhere here. Look all you like, take your pick

chinese: 客人真是好眼光，Ｅ只賣Ｆ
english: A fine eye, sir. The price:  Ｅ - Ｆ

chinese: 你這Ｅ只能賣Ｆ
english: That of yours can only fetch:  Ｅ - Ｆ

chinese: MStg04.ANM
MStg05.ANM
唉‧‧我至死還受人操縱！
english: Ah... even in death I'm still worked like a puppet.

chinese: 為什麼？
english: Why?

chinese: 悲慘的故事才剛剛開始‧‧我死去的人生卻結束不了‧‧
english: The miserable story has only just begun... and my dead life can't come to an end...

chinese: 到底是什麼悲慘的故事？
english: What miserable story?

chinese: 我原是住在德佳古村的居民，前陣子村裡流行瘟疫，每個人都死了，如果說我死後該下地獄我無話可說，但我卻到了一個比地獄更痛苦的地方‧‧
english: I used to live in Dejia Old Town. A plague went through and everyone died. If I deserved hell after death I'd have nothing to say, but I ended up somewhere worse than hell...

chinese: 你認識一位叫洛莎的婦女嗎？你死後又到了那裡？
english: Do you know a woman called Rosa? And where did you go after you died?

chinese: 我不認識這位婦女！它說：我不散播陽光，不散播愛，只散播死亡的種子，因為我是製造病毒的大玩家‧‧瘟疫使者！就是它害死我們村人，只因為它需要奴隸及私人軍隊，為了這個理由，我們就成為滿足它私心的祭品！
english: I don't know her. It said: I spread no love, only seeds of death, for I make plagues... the Envoy of Pestilence. It killed our village for slaves and an army. We were its offering.

chinese: 聽到這個消息使我心亂如麻！媽，你可不要待在德佳古才好‧‧
english: Hearing this leaves my mind in knots. Mother, I hope you didn't stay in Dejia...

chinese: 先不要想這麼多！說不定你母親並沒有留在德佳古。
english: Don't think too far ahead. Your mother may not have stayed in Dejia at all.

speaker: 0C
chinese: 穿過這片森林就是德佳古了。
english: Once we are through this forest, we reach Dejia Old Town.

chinese: 當一個人沒有血沒有肉沒有五臟六腑，剩下的也只是白骨一堆還有‧‧古銅幣一枚。
english: When a man has no blood, no flesh, no organs, all that is left is a pile of white bones and... one old bronze coin.

chinese: MStg78.ANM
年輕人！我的冤魂不散，四處游移！
english: Young man! My wronged spirit will not rest. It drifts everywhere.

chinese: 為什麼？
english: Why?

chinese: 我是德佳古村的村長艾德，我與全村的居民都死於瘟疫，而造成這場悲劇的劊子手就是瘟疫使者這個喪盡天良的惡魔‧‧
english: I am Ed, village chief of Dejia Old Town. My people and I all died of the plague, and the butcher behind it was that heartless demon, the Envoy of Pestilence...

chinese: 村長你知道一位叫洛莎的婦女嗎？
english: Chief, did you know a woman called Rosa?

chinese: 我認識！她在我家中幫佣，不過，她也難逃一劫！
english: I did! She was a servant in my house. But she could not escape it either.

chinese: 嗚‧‧媽‧‧媽‧‧命運的無情使我們生離死別！我發誓，我一定要討回公道！
english: Ugh... Mother... Mother... Fate was cruel enough to part us for good. I swear I will see justice done!

chinese: 原來你是洛莎的兒子，她時常提起你。
english: So you are Rosa's son. She spoke of you often.

chinese: ‧‧‧村長！你知道要怎樣才能找到瘟疫使者？
english: ...Chief! Do you know how I can find the Envoy of Pestilence?

chinese: 它就藏身在這片森林的某處，詳細的地點我並不清楚，我想你母親一定不願意你去做一些危害到自身安全的事情，或許你會幫助我
english: It hides somewhere in this forest, though I do not know where. Your mother would not want you risking your life. Perhaps you could help me instead.

chinese: 如果我有找到的話！
english: If I happen to find one!

chinese: 麻煩你了！有了拯救亡靈符我再也不用做孤魂野鬼。
english: I am in your debt. With the Soul Rescue Charm I will not have to wander as a lost ghost.

chinese: 小兄弟！找到了嗎？我有迫切的需要！
english: Young man! Have you found it? My need is urgent.

chinese: 拜託你不要漫無目的的閒晃，救人一命勝造七級浮屠！
english: Please do not just wander about aimlessly. Saving one life is worth more than a lifetime of good deeds.

chinese: 我脫離苦海了！現在我告訴你我家中保險箱鑰匙藏於何處，鑰匙就放在我的屍體裡，在德佳古有一棟最大的屋子那就是我的家，你可以找到我的屍體，保險箱就在我的房間裡。
english: I am free of my torment! Now I'll tell you where my safe key is hidden. It is inside my corpse. The biggest house in Dejia is mine. You'll find my body there, and the safe in my room.

chinese: 希望你下輩子能有個幸福人生！
english: I hope you get a happy life in the next one.

chinese: 你可曾擔心瘟疫使者是否還會繼續為害人間？你對自己的關心遠超過對人世間的關懷，你以為有錢就可以獲得一切，我看不出來還有什麼人比你更適合做孤魂野鬼！
english: Have you once worried whether the Envoy of Pestilence still preys on the world? You care only for yourself and think money buys all. No one better suits being a lost ghost.

chinese: 你也不要以為只要有正義感就可獲得一切！
english: And do not think a sense of justice buys everything either!

chinese: MStg34.ANM
MStg35.ANM
我需要拯救亡靈符使我早日投胎，以我的財產做為答謝
english: I need the Soul Rescue Charm so I can be reborn soon. My fortune is yours as thanks.

chinese: 勇士彫像寫著：帶著我的裝備，讓我看到你的心意！
english: The warrior statue reads: bring me my gear, and let me see what is in your heart.

chinese: 很好，我就是要錢！
english: Good. Money is exactly what I want.

chinese: 找到再來！
english: Come back when you have found it!

chinese: 我已有錢！
english: I already have money!

chinese: 這一匹死馬只剩下骨架，因為它爛的該死！
english: This dead horse is nothing but a frame of bones, because it was rotten as hell.

chinese: 對了，就是弓弩！
english: That is it. The crossbow!

chinese: 找到再來見我！
english: Find it and come back to me!

chinese: 我已有弓弩！
english: I already have a crossbow!

chinese: 這一匹死馬只剩下軀體，因為它笨的該死！
english: This dead horse is nothing but a carcass, because it was stupid as hell.

chinese: 對了，就是盾牌！
english: That is it. The shield!

chinese: 找到再來見我！
english: Find it and come back to me!

chinese: 我已有盾牌！
english: I already have a shield!

chinese: 這棵大樹矗立在路口，它的樹枝如同難得一見的材質！
english: This great tree stands at the crossroads. Its branches look like a material you rarely ever see.

chinese: 我的領域怎麼會有活人的氣息？你們是來找死！
english: How is there the scent of the living in my domain? You have come here to die!

chinese: 你為了私慾害死包含我母親在內的所有德佳古的居民，你就算被我砍死一萬次也無法洗淨罪孽！
english: For your own greed you killed everyone in Dejia, my mother among them. Cutting you down ten thousand times would not wash that guilt away!

chinese: 既然你報仇心切，那麼我就陪你玩玩！
english: Since you are so eager for revenge, I will play along.

chinese: 你們竟然毀了我的五骨大將‧‧我若是不替它們報仇，我做老大的臉往那癒I
english: You actually destroyed my Five Bone Generals... If I do not avenge them, how do I show my face as their boss?

chinese: 來吧，今天不是你死就是我亡！
english: Come on. Today one of us dies!

chinese: 我‧雖‧‧然打敗了，但‧‧但是‧我的師兄痛苦使者‧會‧會替我報‧報仇的‧‧他會帶來更多的血腥‧‧你們拭‧目‧以‧待‧‧。
english: I... have... lost, but... but my elder brother, the Envoy of Pain... will... will avenge me... he will bring far more blood... just... wait... and... see...

chinese: 正好我也要找那個懦夫。

chinese: 鐵鑰匙！

chinese: 這個箱子裡放有命石。

chinese: MonB3A.ANM
媽！都是我不好，都是我惹出來的麻煩！只因為我一時的好奇使那麼多的人喪命，在我這一生中，終將承受無止盡的良心煎熬！嗚‧嗚‧媽！我會為自己的行為負責，縱然付出生命也不後悔！
english: Mother! This is all my fault, all my doing! One moment of curiosity cost so many lives. I'll carry that guilt all my life. Ugh... ugh... Mother! I'll answer for it, even with my life.

chinese: 讓伯母入土為安吧！
english: Let us lay your mother to rest.

chinese: 嗚‧嗚‧‧我母親生前說要火葬！
english: Ugh... ugh... My mother said while she lived that she wanted to be cremated.

chinese: 媽！從今以後，我再也沒有親人了‧‧您若地下有知，讓我與父親相見‧‧
english: Mother! From now on I have no family left... If you can hear me down there, let me find my father...

找到金銀鑰匙。
english: Found the gold and silver key.

chinese: 得到祭文之杖。
english: Obtained the staff of rites.

chinese: 找到古銅鑰匙。
english: Found the old bronze key.

chinese: MStg36.ANM
這裡就是德佳古了‧‧當一個人明瞭未來可能發生的事情之後，所有的痛苦情緒也已面臨爆發的時刻！
english: So this is Dejia... Once a man understands what may be coming, all the pain in him reaches the point of bursting out.

chinese: 整座村子已經成為人間地獄！
english: The whole village has become a hell on earth.

speaker: 0C
chinese: 我一直認為魔鬼只是人們心中的幻想，然而，它們竟真實地存在著！
english: I always thought devils were only something people imagined. And yet here they are, real.

chinese: 一顆紅寶石。
english: A ruby.

chinese: 小兄弟‧‧快‧快‧救救我‧‧我染上‧瘟疫‧恐怕命在旦夕‧聽說在碎冥墓穴裡有把銀匕首‧‧能夠醫治瘟疫‧你們願意幫我嗎？
english: Young man... please... save me... I caught the plague... I may not last the day... They say a silver dagger in the Shattered Gloom Crypt can cure it... will you help me?

chinese: 你撐著點，我們馬上就去找銀匕首！
english: Hold on. We will go and find the silver dagger right now!

chinese: 過了村外的針織橋向北走就可見到一片山壁，找到石頭基座將祭文之杖插上，就可打開入口，那兒是貴族墳場，必須有祭文之杖才能進入，此杖在村長家中可以找到，一切拜託了！
english: Cross the Needlework Bridge outside the village and go north to a cliff. Set the staff of rites in the stone base to open the nobles' graveyard. The staff is in the chief's house.

chinese: 你放心，我們會盡力的！
english: Do not worry. We will do all we can.

chinese: 找到銀匕首了嗎？我並不怕死，只是不甘心！
english: Have you found the silver dagger? I am not afraid to die, I just cannot accept it.

chinese: 小兄弟，不要讓我死不瞑目！
english: Young man, do not let me die with regrets.

chinese: 你們找到銀匕首了，只要在我身上劃一刀，體內的毒氣就會被吸收，呼‧呼‧好多了！謝謝你們的救命之恩，不知道你們要去那裡？
english: You found the silver dagger. One cut on my body and the poison inside will be drawn out. Hah... hah... much better. Thank you for saving my life. Where are you headed?

chinese: 這個世界已經成為惡魔的樂園，我們要摧毀這座樂園，這就是我們的目的！
english: This world has become a playground for demons. We mean to destroy that playground. That is our purpose.

chinese: 我是武士，掃除邪惡，行俠仗義是我的信念！讓我加入你們？
english: I am a warrior. Sweeping away evil and standing up for the weak is what I believe in. Let me join you.

chinese: 太好了，我們又多了一份力量！
english: Excellent. That is one more sword on our side.

chinese: 我是Ｃ，很高興認識你們！

chinese: 你的身體才剛剛復原，還是安心療養較好！
english: Your body has only just recovered. You would do better to rest.

chinese: 兄弟既然無意讓我加入，那麼‧後會有期！謝謝你們的救命之恩，今生今世永不忘懷！
english: If you do not want me along, then... until we meet again. Thank you for saving my life. I will never forget it.

chinese: 再見，請保重！
english: Goodbye. Take care.

chinese: 你已病入膏肓，恐怕緩不濟急，告辭！
english: You are too far gone. Nothing would come in time. Farewell.

chinese: 見死不救，你於心何安！
english: You would watch a man die and do nothing. How can you live with that?

chinese: 很遺憾，他死了！
english: It is a shame. He is dead.

chinese: 你真是個木頭！

chinese: 你找到我的化粧箱了嗎？

chinese: 我老婆若是見到我與陌生人說話，他會不高興。
english: If my wife saw me talking to a stranger, she would be upset.

chinese: 我不要跟你說話，我想跟你聊聊‧‧你住在這附近嗎？
english: I do not want to talk to you, I want to chat with you... Do you live somewhere near here?

chinese: 親愛的！你為什麼與陌生人說話呢？走，我們回家去！
english: Darling! Why are you talking to a stranger? Come, we are going home.

chinese: 這位女士我想請問‧‧
english: Madam, I wanted to ask you...

chinese: 我們要回家了！
english: We are going home!

chinese: MStg62.ANM
這一對夫妻很古怪！
english: There is something very strange about that couple.

chinese: 這裡又是何處？
english: And where are we now?

chinese: 我覺得有必要追查下去！
english: I think we need to look into this.

chinese: MStg61.ANM
老婆婆妳怎麼了？是誰這樣對妳？我去找醫生！
english: What happened to you, grandmother? Who did this? I will find a doctor!

chinese: 不‧不用了，我想‧我‧撐不下去了！唉！我實在是於心不忍，那麼小的孩子要忍受那種折磨‧‧
english: No... no need. I do not think... I can hold on. Ah! I could not bear it, a child that small having to suffer like that...

chinese: 我經過樹林並沒有看到小孩。
english: I came through the woods and saw no child.

chinese: 是我放了那孩子！只怪我太粗心了，我在解開繩子的時候，將黑皮書遺落在現場，衛兵憑著那本書找到我，我以為他們是要來還書，沒想到是來要我的命！
english: I set that child free! My own carelessness: untying the ropes, I left the Black Book behind, and the guards used it to find me. I thought they came to return it. They came for my life.

chinese: 啊‧‧啊！在我臨死之前請幫我一個忙，將這本書交給曼德拉‧‧謝‧謝‧你！
english: Ah... ah! Before I die, do one thing for me. Take this book to Mandela... Thank... you.

chinese: 老婆婆斷氣了！為什麼這些貴族及走狗和有錢人可以為所欲為？這本黑皮書到底在寫什麼呢？都是我看不懂的字。我還是先將老婆婆安葬，再去找曼德拉。
english: She has stopped breathing. Why can these nobles and rich men do as they please? What does this Black Book say? I cannot read a word. I will bury her first, then find Mandela.

chinese: 老婆婆您安息吧！
english: Rest in peace, grandmother.

chinese: 讓開！讓開！
english: Out of the way! Out of the way!

chinese: 沒有禮貌的走狗！
english: Ill-mannered lackey.

chinese: MStg07.ANM
MStg08.ANM
我應該稱呼妳‧‧狐狸精！
english: I should call you what you are... a fox spirit.

chinese: 你想怎麼樣？
english: What do you want?

chinese: 你的先生是人？還是狐狸？
english: Is your husband a man, or a fox?

chinese: 我們井水不犯河水！你何必打擾我幸福的生活‧‧
english: We keep to ourselves and you keep to yours. Why must you disturb the happy life I have...

chinese: 我想妳先生就是達斯！你知不知道他父親終日以淚洗臉就望著他回家？
english: I believe your husband is Das. Do you know his father has wept every day, waiting for him to come home?

chinese: 我很愛他，我們要長相廝守！
english: I love him. We mean to spend our lives together.

chinese: 放了他！否則我不客氣了！
english: Let him go, or I stop being polite.

chinese: 你要拆散我們，我只有跟你拼了！
english: If you mean to tear us apart, I will fight you to the death!

chinese: 求求你放了我‧‧我若死了，我的孩子也會餓死‧‧我願意解掉達斯身上的咒語，如此他就會忘了這一切‧‧
english: I beg you, let me go... if I die my children will starve too... I will lift the spell on Das, and he will forget all of this...

chinese: 我放妳一條生路，妳也放了達斯！
english: I will spare your life, and you will free Das.

chinese: 阿依嗚拉！我已經解除咒語了‧‧謝謝你放過我及我的孩子，這是拯救亡靈符，留給我也沒用，就給你吧！
english: Aiwula! The spell is broken... Thank you for sparing me and my children. Here, take the Soul Rescue Charm. It is no use to me.

speaker: 6A
chinese: 春夢了無痕！
english: A dream of spring leaves no trace behind.

chinese: 妳死了，達斯身上的咒語自然也會解除，我不會留著這一窩禍害的小命以後再來害人！
english: With you dead the spell on Das will lift by itself. I am not leaving this nest of vermin alive to prey on people later.

speaker: 6A
chinese: 人類是世上最無情的動物！
english: Humans are the cruelest animals in this world.

speaker: 6A
chinese: 這裡發生了什麼事？我為什麼會在這裡？我做了一個好長的夢‧‧很甜蜜的夢！
english: What happened here? Why am I in this place? I had such a long dream... such a sweet dream.

chinese: ‧‧‧你是達斯吧！快回家，你父親很擔心！
english: ...You must be Das. Go home quickly, your father is worried sick.

speaker: 6A
chinese: 好奇怪的感覺！深刻的記憶在我腦海迴盪，我就是想不起來！
english: What a strange feeling. Some deep memory keeps echoing in my head, and I just cannot bring it back.

speaker: 6A
chinese: 我老婆說：不可以跟陌生人說話。
english: My wife says I am not to talk to strangers.

chinese: MStg63.ANM
MStg64.ANM

MonB6A.ANM
我無黨無派，無錢可吃飯，無錢買衣服，但是我過的有尊嚴。
english: I belong to no party and no faction. I have no money for food and no money for clothes, but I live with my dignity.

chinese: 我兩眼昏花，四肢無力，不要為我收屍，這塊土地會為我哭泣‧‧
english: My eyes are dim and my limbs have no strength. Do not bother burying me. This land will weep for me...

chinese: 我喜歡妳的大眼睛，喜歡妳的長頭髮，喜歡妳的腳趾頭，現在我們要幹什麼？
english: I like your big eyes, I like your long hair, I like your toes. So what are we doing now?

chinese: 你錢帶的夠嗎？夠的話一切好辦事！
english: Did you bring enough money? If you did, everything is easy.

chinese: 年輕人！你若是第一次，來這裡就對了，這裡紅包多，小姐多，快樂多！少年家別害羞，老的功夫好，咱來去！
english: Young man! If this is your first time, you've come to the right place. Good tips, plenty of girls, plenty of fun. Don't be shy, lad, the older ones know their work. Come on!

chinese: 妳令我倒足胃口！
english: You have completely killed my appetite.

chinese: 我要牽妳的手，摸妳的屁股，吃妳的豆腐，我們一起去打‧‧拼‧‧打‧‧
english: I want to hold your hand, touch your backside, get my hands all over you, and the two of us will work... hard... at...

chinese: 我要你的錢，我不要你激烈的呼吸，也別想聽到我含糊的低吟！
english: I want your money. I do not want your heavy breathing, and do not expect to hear me moaning either.

chinese: 妳在說什麼？
english: What are you talking about?

chinese: 我不管，你要替我贖身！
english: I do not care. You are going to buy me out of here.

chinese: 珠珠！再給我一次機會，妳會得到滿足！
english: Zhuzhu! Give me one more chance, you will not be disappointed.

chinese: 去！去！去！沒錢又沒功夫！
english: Go! Go! Go! No money and no skill either.

chinese: 來吧！蓬門今始為君開！
english: Come in. My humble gate opens today for you.

chinese: 小姐，門已經快開壞了，妳在燃燒自己的靈魂！
english: Miss, that gate is nearly worn off its hinges. You are burning up your own soul.

chinese: 你們這些臭男人，可以得到我的肉體，永遠得不到我的靈魂！我是聖潔的天使，洗淨你全身污穢
english: You stinking men can have my body, but you will never have my soul. I am a holy angel, washing away all the filth on you.

chinese: 那些帶著不敬尋找發洩對像的男子，都將受到地獄最恐怖的刑罰，讓雄雄烈燄吞噬他們的哭喊！永恆不息‧‧
english: Every man who comes here without reverence, looking for somewhere to empty himself, will suffer the worst of hell. Let the roaring flames swallow their screams, forever without end...

chinese: 好嚴厲的說法！是誰灌輸妳這麼可怕的想法？
english: That is a harsh thing to say. Who put such a terrible idea into your head?

chinese: 我最敬愛的父親！他讓我了解身為女人的價值！他替我算過命，他告訴我：只要接客滿七千人，我會昇天，成為最美麗的天使，從今以後我的生活只有快樂沒有憂愁！
english: My beloved father. He taught me what a woman is worth. He read my fortune: take seven thousand customers and I'll rise to heaven as the most beautiful angel, with only joy ever after.

chinese: 妳父親會算命？
english: Your father tells fortunes?

chinese: 他在嘉露城替人算命，他的法力高深，變幻莫測，他有個祭壇就在怖懼山洞內，不過，我從來沒去過。你要不成為我第一千個客人？可以打折！
english: He reads fortunes in Jialu City. His powers run deep and change beyond following. He has an altar inside Dread Cavern, though I've never been. Be my thousandth customer? At a discount!

chinese: 等妳成為美麗的天使再說吧！
english: Ask me again once you are a beautiful angel.

chinese: 離目標還有距離，還得多接客！
english: I am still short of my target. I need more customers.

chinese: 妳父親死了‧‧醒醒吧！再這裡工作絕對無法成為天使，妳只是妳父親的一顆搖錢樹！
english: Your father is dead... Wake up. Working here will never make you an angel. You were only ever your father's money tree.

chinese: 你胡說‧你胡說‧我不相信！他為什麼死了？
english: You are lying... you are lying... I do not believe you! Why would he be dead?

chinese: 謊話說多，咬斷舌頭，暴斃而亡！
english: Tell enough lies and you bite your tongue off and drop dead.

chinese: 我不相信你說的！我一定要成為天使安慰他的再天之靈！
english: I do not believe a word of it! I will become an angel and comfort his spirit in heaven.

chinese: 愚蠢到極點了！這世界到處都是謊言，無恥的謊言！
english: This is stupid beyond words. The world is full of lies, shameless lies.

chinese: 你才是騙子，低級的騙子！
english: You are the liar. A cheap, filthy liar.

chinese: 我不要再見到你了！給我出去！
english: I never want to see you again. Get out!

chinese: 這裡是捷里沙，本鎮有最發達的造船業，可惜的是本鎮手藝最好的造船匠達斯已經失蹤一個多月了。
english: This is Jielisha. The town has the finest shipbuilding trade anywhere, but sadly our best shipwright, Das, has been missing for over a month.

chinese: 本鎮的海鮮物美價廉，窮人還是吃不起！
english: The seafood here is good and cheap, and the poor still cannot afford it.

chinese: 有個奇怪的晚上，母親輕輕地叫著我的名字，滿懷憂傷的坐在我身邊，淚水從她的臉龐落下，說著父親海枯石爛不
english: One strange night my mother said my name softly, sat beside me full of sorrow, tears down her face, speaking of my father's love that would last till the seas dried up and the stones

chinese: 變的愛情，一切已成往事，她聲音急切迴盪在窒息的空氣中，我成為慾望的依靠，短暫的激情終點‧‧‧
english: crumbled. It is all in the past now. Her voice was urgent, echoing in the airless room. I became something for her longing to lean on, the end of a brief passion...

chinese: 然後呢？
english: And then?

chinese: 我游移在痛苦與快樂的天地，荒謬一如往昔的世界，誰來告訴我她是誰？誰來問我願不願意‧‧‧
english: I drift between pain and pleasure, in a world as absurd as it ever was. Who will tell me who she is? Who will ask me whether I want this...

chinese: 我要逃避這整個世界！
english: I want to run from this whole world!

chinese: 我媽媽給人洗衣服，我爸爸在市場砍人十刀去坐牢，我妹妹下海賣身，我窮的只能幻想兼流口水，我到底要幹‧‧什麼？我要幹‧‧什麼才能出頭天‧‧‧
english: My mother takes in washing, my father is in jail for knifing a man at the market, my sister sells herself. I'm so poor all I do is dream and drool. What do I do... to get ahead...

chinese: 我要反抗權威，顛覆虛構制度！我就是道路，我就是真理，我就是生命！
english: I will defy authority and tear down this sham of a system! I am the way, I am the truth, I am the life!

chinese: 我對這個社會失望，對這個朝代絕望！
english: I have lost faith in this society, and all hope in this dynasty.

chinese: 怖懼山洞現在封鎖中，有位貴族在山洞內失蹤！
english: Dread Cavern is sealed off at the moment. A nobleman went missing inside it.

chinese: 我的老公年近六旬，還像一尾活龍！
english: My husband is nearly sixty and still as lively as a dragon.

chinese: 我想知道什麼是憐憫，這個問題一直困擾著我，有人說：人不為己天誅地滅，但又有人願意捨己助人，為什麼？你若是能解開我心中的疑問，我會毫不吝惜的送你真絹！
english: I want to know what pity is. It troubles me. Some say a man who doesn't look out for himself is doomed, yet others give up all to help. Why? Answer that and the True Silk is yours.

chinese: 我盡我所能！
english: I will do what I can.

chinese: 我要知道什麼是憐憫！你現在能告訴我嗎？
english: I want to know what pity is. Can you tell me now?

chinese: 不！
english: No!

chinese: 沒有答案！
english: There is no answer.

chinese: 很好！我想的確是沒有答案，這是真絹。
english: Very good. I believe there truly is no answer. Here is the True Silk.

chinese: 我現在比較擔心的是，我的孩子能不能用功讀書，復興民族！
english: What worries me more these days is whether my children will study hard and restore our people.

chinese: 是否要休息！
english: Rest here?

chinese: 我心急如焚！我的兒子達斯出外找尋木材製造船隻，竟離奇失蹤，生死不明，活著我要見到人，死了我要看到屍體
english: My heart is on fire. My son Das went out looking for timber to build ships and vanished. I do not know if he lives. If he lives I want to see him, if he is dead I want to see the body

chinese: ，唉！年輕人，做人要行善積德，請幫我一個忙，幫我找到他！
english: . Ah! Young man, a man should do good and build up merit. Please do me this one favor and find him.

chinese: 老先生，您放心！我會幫忙。
english: Do not worry, sir. I will help.

chinese: 謝謝你們，謝謝你們！
english: Thank you, thank you both!

chinese: 你的熱心令我老淚縱橫！
english: Your kindness brings tears to these old eyes.

chinese: 謝謝你們找回我的兒子！等達斯將船造好之好，你們就能得到一艘船。
english: Thank you for bringing my son back. Once Das has finished building the ship, it is yours.

chinese: 太謝謝您了！
english: Thank you very much.

chinese: 我不知道該不該謝謝你‧‧我真的很喜歡那個狐狸精。
english: I do not know whether I should thank you... I truly loved that fox spirit.

chinese: 船已經造好了，從今以後它就是你們的了
english: The ship is finished. From today it belongs to you.

chinese: 它正好派的上用場。
english: It will come in useful.

chinese: 船已經造好了，這是我與我兒子的心意！
english: The ship is finished. It is a gift from my son and me.

chinese: 謝謝！
english: Thank you!

chinese: 行善積德的方式有很多，不一定非得要找你兒子！況且你應該向有關單位報案，而不是找我幫忙！
english: There are many ways to do good, and finding your son is not the only one. Besides, you should report this to the authorities, not ask me.

chinese: 找有關單位幫忙‧‧哈‧哈‧我人老，腦子還沒老！
english: Ask the authorities for help... ha, ha. I am old, but my head still works.

chinese: 兒子啊！兒子啊！你若是遭到不測，就托夢給我，也好讓我給你收屍‧‧嗚‧嗚‧嗚！
english: My son, my son! If something has happened to you, come to me in a dream so I can bury you at least... Ugh... ugh... ugh!

chinese: 不管如何，你找回我兒子我還是要謝謝你！等到我兒子將船造好後，你若是有需要，我可以以低廉的價格賣給你。
english: Either way, you brought my son back and I still thank you. Once he has finished the ship, I can sell it to you cheap if you need it.

chinese: 我忘不掉那段美夢！
english: I cannot forget that beautiful dream.

chinese: 要買船嗎？一艘一萬五千圓！
english: Want to buy a ship? Fifteen thousand gold each.

chinese: 好！
english: Yes!

chinese: 它就停在石斑港！
english: It is moored at Shiban Harbor.

chinese: 乘風破浪，遨遊四海！
english: Ride the wind, cut the waves, and roam the four seas!

chinese: 不要！
english: No!

chinese: 你再也找不到價格如此低廉的船隻！
english: You will never find a ship at a price like that again.

我的女朋友小梅前天在此跳海自殺，我們深愛著對方，卻無法結合，她是富家女，我是窮小子！
english: My girlfriend Xiaomei drowned herself here the day before yesterday. We loved each other deeply and could never be together. She was a rich man's daughter and I am a poor boy.

chinese: 你該不會準備自殺吧？
english: You are not planning to kill yourself, are you?

chinese: 我再也活不下去‧‧
english: I cannot go on living...

chinese: 自殺是懦弱的行為！
english: Killing yourself is a coward's way out.

chinese: 我寫了一篇祭梅文，請你聽聽看！
english: I wrote a lament for Mei. Please, listen to it.

chinese: 如果這能使你打消念頭！
english: If it will change your mind.

chinese: 再妳未與我吻別前別叫醒我妳再也見不到我艱辛地游過深藍的海水潮來潮往是我的深情最深的悲哀深於淚水沙
english: Do not wake me before you kiss me goodbye you will never see me again struggling across the deep blue sea the tides are my devotion the deepest grief runs deeper than tears the

chinese: 灘的足跡聆聽晚風習習清澈冷冽帶不走希望如緣木求魚般的無情無奈思念點燃創痛燭火愛情是淒苦破碎的？？
english: footprints on the sand listen to the evening wind clear and cold it carries no hope as futile as chasing fish up a tree longing lights the candle of pain is love bitter and broken??

chinese: 等待！
english: Waiting!

chinese: 用等待劃下我人生的句點‧‧這把右花扇送給你，小梅我們終究會在一起‧‧
english: I will end my life with waiting... Take this right-flower fan. Xiaomei, in the end we will be together...

chinese: 他為愛殉情！我的淚水再也不聽使喚‧‧
english: He died for love. My tears will not obey me anymore...

chinese: 用美夢劃下我人生的句點‧‧小梅我們終究會在一起‧‧
english: I will end my life with a beautiful dream... Xiaomei, in the end we will be together...

chinese: 他為愛殉情！我的淚水再也不聽使喚‧‧
english: He died for love. My tears will not obey me anymore...

chinese: 用感覺劃下我人生的句點‧‧小梅我們終究會在一起‧‧
english: I will end my life with feeling... Xiaomei, in the end we will be together...

chinese: 他為愛殉情！我的淚水再也不聽使喚‧‧
english: He died for love. My tears will not obey me anymore...

我要成為人類！我不要這副醜陋的德性，幫助我好不好？我的身軀是由十位孩童所創造出來的，那群巫師賦于我血腥的生命
english: I want to become human! I do not want this hideous shape. Will you help me? My body was made out of ten children, and those sorcerers gave me a life soaked in blood

chinese: 所以我只要吃掉十位孩童的屍體，我就能成為人類！如果你幫助我達成心願，我送給你泊天神蛹！
english: so all I need is to eat the bodies of ten children and I can become human. Help me get my wish and I will give you the Heavenbound Pupa.

chinese: 我願意幫助你！
english: I will help you.

chinese: 麻煩你們找到十具童屍！
english: Please find me ten children's corpses.

chinese: 我好想趕快成為人類！
english: I so badly want to be human soon.

chinese: 謝謝你們的幫助！這是泊天神蛹。
english: Thank you for your help. Here is the Heavenbound Pupa.

chinese: 我不能幫你，聽起來匪夷所思！
english: I cannot help you. What you are asking is monstrous.

chinese: 我好失望，只有靠自己！
english: I am so disappointed. I will have to manage alone.

chinese: 我再也不是正常人了！
english: I will never be a normal person again.

chinese: 謝謝你們的幫助！
english: Thank you for your help.

chinese: MStg81.ANM
MStg120.ANM
從水井內傳出訊息：不想喝也得喝！
english: A message comes up out of the well: you will drink whether you want to or not.

chinese: 我喝！
english: I will drink!

chinese: 我不喝！
english: I will not drink!

chinese: 這塊巨石為什麼矗立在這裡？石頭上為什麼又有這張符咒？撕下來看看好了！
english: Why does this great stone stand here? And why is there a charm stuck on it? I may as well tear it off and see.

chinese: 哇！你是什麼人？你以這種方式出現令我感到訝異！
english: Whoa! Who are you? Appearing like that gives me quite a shock.

chinese: 我從閃光中出現意味著我將照亮你的人生，你的未來也將因為我而改變，從今以後你的生命也將充滿著危險，卻也遍佈著希望，你無法從我這得到更多的指引，你的歡樂與痛苦也都將屬於你！
english: I came from the light to light your life. Your future changes because of me. From now your life holds danger and hope alike. I can guide you no further. Joy and pain are yours.

chinese: 我聽了比沒聽還糊塗！
english: I understand less now than before you spoke.

chinese: 這塊巨石就是所謂的亡朝碑！當你將鎮壓符撕下的時候也就是黑暗力量的甦醒，嘿！嘿！不過黑暗之後‧也許光明既將到來！但是，你該如何驅走黑暗帶來光明‧‧
english: This boulder is the Stele of the Fallen Dynasty. Tearing off the sealing charm wakes the dark power. Heh, heh. After the dark, perhaps light. But how will you bring it...

chinese: 我該怎麼辦？
english: What should I do?

chinese: 別打斷我的話，這正是我要告訴你的！仔細聽好，我能給你的幫助也僅止於此！這個世界隱藏著巨大的秘密，這個秘密關係著摩羅王朝的存亡，只要你能找齊十樣聖物‧‧
english: Do not interrupt, this is what I'm telling you. Listen well, this is all the help I can give. This world hides a vast secret, and on it hangs the Moro Dynasty. Gather ten holy items...

chinese: 你的意思是說如果我能解開秘密，我就能推翻摩羅王朝？
english: You mean if I can uncover the secret, I can bring down the Moro Dynasty?

chinese: 你若是記憶力不佳，注意力不集中，想像力不豐富，我想你絕對無法完成推翻摩羅王朝的壯舉‧‧聽清楚了！找到未見箴圖、蓮花若木、雲雷風鼓、玄白赤鼎、泊天神俑、斑瀾文簡，獻給六手甲乙佛‧‧
english: Find the Unseen Admonition, Lotus Ruo-Tree, Cloud-Thunder Drum, Tricolor Cauldron, Heavenbound Effigy and Resplendent Slips for the Six-Armed Buddha...

chinese: 六手甲乙佛在那裏？祂又能給我什麼樣的幫助？
english: Where is the Six-Armed Buddha of Jiayi? And what help can he give me?

chinese: 在裂風地窖！進入裂風地窖的關鍵就在亡朝碑上，接下來無可奉告！看你滿臉迷惑我在透露一點提示，六手甲乙佛的手上不一定都要有東西，不過，你也可以不用相信我！六手甲乙佛祂可以使聖光島昇起。
english: In the Windrift Vault. The key to entering is on the Stele of the Fallen Dynasty. Beyond that, nothing. One hint: his six hands need not all hold something. He can raise Holy Island.

chinese: 聖光島？你剛剛有提到真絹、命石、天玉、子燭？
english: Holy Island? You mentioned True Silk, a Life Stone, Heavenly Jade, the Child Candle?

chinese: 聖光島！如果你到的了聖光島就能決定你未來的命運！這四樣聖物取前面一個字，合起來就是真命天子，你用不著高興的太早，我不認為你辦的到！當然了，這四樣物品與聖光島是有密切的關係。
english: Holy Island! Reach it and you decide your fate. Take the first word of each: True, Life, Heaven, Child. Do not celebrate yet, I do not think you can. All four are tied to Holy Island.

chinese: 如果你認為我辦不到，你又何必告訴我該怎麼做？
english: If you think I cannot do it, why bother telling me how?

chinese: 如果你找不到這裡，如果你不把鎮壓符撕掉，我又何必告訴你？這一切都是天的旨意，我知道你心裏在想什麼！你不過把這一段當成是生命中的奇遇，何不回頭看看來時路‧‧
english: If you'd not found this place, if you'd not torn off the sealing charm, why would I? It is all heaven's will. I know your thoughts: a strange episode. Look back at the road you came.

chinese: 你好像已經知道我所碰到的事情！
english: You seem to know already what has happened to me.

chinese: 在過不久，你就能感受到黑暗力量的甦醒，這個禍是你闖的，你不能逃避！找出黑暗的存在，然後消滅它！
english: Before long you will feel the dark power waking. This trouble is yours, you brought it, and you cannot run from it. Find where the darkness is, and destroy it.

chinese: 我‧我‧現在‧‧
english: I... I... right now...

chinese: 哈！哈！回家去吧！我也該走了！
english: Ha! Ha! Go home. And I should be going too.

chinese: 等一下！你到底是什麼人？好人還是壞人？
english: Wait! Just who are you? Good or evil?

chinese: 那麼你是好人還是壞人呢？我是來自終極歷程的不朽先知！
english: And which are you, good or evil? I am the undying prophet out of the final journey.

chinese: 我還有好多疑問你人就走了！‧‧我是好人還是壞人？唉！回家去吧！想到黑暗的力量我就渾身無力！
english: I still had so many questions and he is gone... Am I good or evil? Ah, go home. Thinking about the dark power drains the strength out of me.

chinese: Stage02.FTC
咦！發生什麼事？！
english: Huh! What is happening?

chinese: Mstg12.ANM
Mstg11.ANM
MStg117.ANM
Stage03.FTC
Mstg118.ANM
聖光島！如果你到的了聖光島就能決定你未來的命運！
english: Holy Island! Reach Holy Island and you decide your own fate.

chinese: HolyLose.FTC
我的臉色隨著陰暗變化！
english: My face changes color as the shadows change.

chinese: MStg84.ANM
MStg82.ANM
MStg83.ANM
由磁磚鑲成的缺角牆壁。
english: A tiled wall with a corner missing.

chinese: 大眼睛的孩子‧‧他再也不會唱兒歌了‧‧
english: The child with the big eyes... he will never sing a nursery rhyme again...

chinese: 孩童的屍體！
english: A child's corpse!

chinese: 我沒有鐵鑰匙
english: I do not have an iron key

chinese: 這個東西看起來有點像標靶！
english: This thing looks a bit like a target.

chinese: 百發百中！
english: A hundred shots, a hundred hits!

chinese: 歡迎來到我的實驗室，不過你們是不速之客！你們為什麼來這裡？
english: Welcome to my laboratory, though you are uninvited. Why have you come here?

chinese: 這些孩子跟你有什麼深仇大恨，為什麼要害死他們？
english: What grudge did these children ever give you? Why did you kill them?

chinese: 這是一個偉大的實驗！只要找出方法，人體有無限發展的的可能，這些孩子正好驗證我聰明絕頂的頭腦！
english: This is a great experiment! Find the right method and the human body can be developed without limit. These children happen to prove how brilliant my mind is.

chinese: 我的刀子也可證明肉體是如此的脆弱，生命是如此的無助！
english: My knife can also prove how fragile the flesh is, and how helpless life is.

chinese: 哈‧哈‧哈‧！
english: Ha, ha, ha!

chinese: 死得其所，死有餘辜！
english: He died where he deserved to, and death is still too good for him.

chinese: 釋聖經是屬於神的，交出來！
english: The Sacred Sutra belongs to god. Hand it over.

chinese: 神在那裡？神是要幹什麼？人求神要幹嗎？人問神要求什麼？求富貴功名！求家財萬貫！這是私心昇華的賄賂‧‧你這個基本教義派！
english: Where is god? What does god do? Why do men pray to him? What do they ask for? Wealth and rank! A fortune in the house! It is a bribe dressed up as devotion... You fundamentalist!

chinese: 你污蔑神！
english: You blaspheme against god!

chinese: 死不悔改的蠢豬！
english: Stubborn pig, dying with nothing learned!

chinese: 基本教義派勝利！
english: The fundamentalist wins!

chinese: 你‧‧再也‧‧拿不到‧釋‧聖‧經‧‧
english: You... will never... get... the Sacred... Sutra...

chinese: 在他身上找到左花扇！
english: Found the left flower fan on him!

chinese: 釋聖經！
english: The Sacred Sutra!

chinese: MonB7A.ANM
這塊碑文寫著：就像男人需要女人，就像紅花需要綠葉，就像城市需要名字，就像夢想需要實現，就像我需要‧‧‧！
english: The inscription reads: as a man needs a woman, as a red flower needs green leaves, as a city needs a name, as a dream needs fulfilling, as I need...!

chinese: 這塊碑文寫著：五十萬年前沒有人跟隨我的腳步，五十萬年後我的屍骨深埋地底任人踐踏，神創造我，你創造未來，我給你希望，你給我‧‧‧！
english: It reads: half a million years ago none followed my steps; half a million years on my bones lie deep to be trodden. God made me, you make the future. I give you hope, you give me...!

chinese: 就快要成功了！
english: Almost there!

chinese: 凝視著妳雪白的肌膚，令我不忍轉移目光，妳看起來是這麼的美好，我相信妳在這種袒裎相見的情況下一定會感到害羞，如果妳願意與我聊聊的話，我願意轉過頭去讓妳將衣服穿好。
english: Looking at your snow-white skin, I cannot look away. You are lovely. Caught bare like this you must feel shy, so if you will talk with me, I will turn around and let you dress.

chinese: 下流！你大概不知道我所擁有的神秘藝術足以讓一個無恥的傢伙化為灰燼，你最好在我還沒有下定決心之前收起你的目光，閉上你的嘴巴，趕快離開！
english: Filthy man! You have no idea that the arts I command could burn a shameless creature like you to ash. Take your eyes off me, shut your mouth and go, before I make up my mind.

chinese: 我只看到人體藝術，沒有見到什麼神秘藝術。
english: All I see is the art of the human body. I do not see any mysterious art.

chinese: 愈說愈離譜，去死吧你！
english: Every word makes it worse. Drop dead!

chinese: 妳為什麼會魔法？魔法師不是都死光了？
english: How do you know magic? Were not all the magicians killed?

chinese: ‧‧那是一場死亡宴會！我父親與其他的魔法師們在接到摩羅王的邀請之後無不認為這是魔法師地位的轉戾點，我忘不掉我父親在準備赴宴時眼中所流露出的光彩，沒想到摩羅王竟然讓這份光彩染上鮮血‧‧
english: ...A banquet of death. When my father and the other magicians got King Moro's invitation, they thought it their turning point. I can't forget the light in his eyes. Moro bloodied it...

chinese: 摩羅王的眼中為什麼容不下魔法師？他又是如何害死這些人的？
english: Why could King Moro not stand the sight of a magician? And how did he kill them?

chinese: 他不過是想了解一個能夠操控大自然力量的人，是否也能預見自己的生死，我想，他已經得到答案了！這個世界沒有永恆的生命，卻有恆久的仇恨，日久天長，難以磨滅。他在菜裏下毒，參加宴會的魔法師，無一倖免！
english: He only wanted to know if a man who commands nature can foresee his own death. He got his answer. There is no eternal life, only lasting hatred time cannot erase. He poisoned the food.

chinese: 妳很恨他！
english: You hate him.

chinese: 殺父之仇，沒齒難忘！我恨不得親手殺了這個無道昏庸，多行不義的老賊！喂！你該看夠了吧？我要穿衣服了！
english: He killed my father. I will never forget it as long as I live. I'd give anything to kill that lawless old thief with my own hands. Hey! Seen enough? I'm getting dressed.

chinese: 我是Ａ，不是喂！目前為止是夠了，希望以後還有機會！我會轉過身去，用不著太緊張，把身體擦乾再將衣服穿上！
english: I am Ａ, not "hey". Enough for now, and I hope there will be another chance. I will turn around. No need to be nervous, dry yourself off and put your clothes on.

chinese: 你用不著描述穿衣的細節，除了摩羅老賊，再來就是你最令我厭惡！
english: You do not need to describe the dressing in detail. After that old thief Moro, you are the next most disgusting man alive.

chinese: 哇‧‧！這是怎麼一回事？難道是世界末日？為什麼當妳說過討厭我，就天搖地動，風雲變色！
english: Whoa! What is going on? Is this the end of the world? Why does the ground shake and the sky turn the moment you say you dislike me?

chinese: 跟這位小姐沒有關係，跟你倒是有關係！你還記得我嗎？還記得是你把亡朝碑上的鎮壓符給撕下的吧？若是都沒忘記的話，現在你所看到的就是黑暗力量，你責任的序幕已經揭開，去殘慟谷吧！
english: Not the lady, you. Remember tearing the sealing charm off the Stele of the Fallen Dynasty? What you see now is the dark power. Your part in this begins. Go to the Vale of Grief.

chinese: 你有什麼責任？黑暗力量是什麼？他是人是鬼？
english: What duty is this? What is the dark power? Is he a man or a ghost?

chinese: 說來話長，整件事情是這樣的‧‧‧是我把黑暗力量釋放出來，因為我的愚行使這個世界產生變化，他告訴我：只要我能找出隱藏在這個世界的巨大秘密，就可以推翻摩羅王朝，不過，我比較擔心黑暗力量！
english: Long story. I released the dark power, and my folly changed it. He said uncovering the great secret hidden here would topple the Moro Dynasty. But the dark power worries me more.

chinese: 也許我可以替你分擔一部份的責任！
english: Perhaps I could carry part of that duty for you.

chinese: 妳並沒有使命感！你不過是想利用我殺掉摩羅王！我並不在乎我是否能推翻摩羅王朝，我在意的是黑暗力量會給這塊土地的人民帶來什麼樣的傷害！我要消滅黑暗的力量，清除這股邪惡的根源！
english: You have no sense of mission, you just want me to kill King Moro. I don't care about toppling the dynasty. I care what the dark power does to this land. I'll destroy it at the root.

chinese: 對！你說的沒錯，妖魔鬼怪就是黑暗的力量，摩羅王就是邪惡的根源！我並沒有利用你的意思，光憑你個人的力量我認為你是在玩命！
english: Yes, you're right. The monsters and demons are the dark power, and King Moro is the root of the evil. I'm not using you. Alone, I think you're gambling with your life.

chinese: 好像是我誤會妳了！好吧，讓我們一塊踏上愛的旅途！嗯‧‧是艱辛的旅途。我該怎麼稱呼妳？
english: It seems I misjudged you. All right, let us set out together on the road of love. Hmm... the hard road, I mean. What should I call you?

chinese: 我是Ｂ，我回家準備一下，待會兒你過來找我，對了！我家在西籬溫泉的北邊，你順著這條路走就可以看到。
english: I am Ｂ. I am going home to get ready. Come and find me shortly. Oh, my house is north of the Xili Hot Spring, just follow this road and you will see it.

chinese: 好！等會見！
english: Good. See you soon.

chinese: 道不同，不相為謀！說明白一點就是不行！
english: Different roads, no shared plans. To put it plainly: no.

chinese: 你會後悔的！一定會後悔！
english: You will regret this. You certainly will.

chinese: 好了嗎？女孩子總是要把自己打扮的漂漂亮亮才肯出門！
english: Ready? A girl always has to make herself pretty before she will go out.

chinese: 廢話少說！
english: Enough talk.

chinese: Mstg05.ANM
Mstg06.ANM
殺父之仇不得不報，妖魔鬼怪不得不除！讓我幫助你好嗎？
english: A father's murder has to be avenged, and monsters have to be destroyed. Will you let me help you?

chinese: 我想你們若是沒有經過正確的程序是不可能見到我的，好奇心已經得到滿足，復仇的時候到了，我知道他許久，也
english: I do not think you could have reached me without going through the proper steps. Your curiosity is satisfied. Now it is time for revenge. I have known of him a long while, and I

chinese: 知道天理昭昭，報應不爽！你們就是天理，而我就是他的報應！正義在向你們招手，我可以提供優厚的報賞！
english: know that heaven sees all and repayment never fails. You are heaven's justice, and I am his reckoning. Justice is beckoning you, and I can offer a rich reward.

chinese: 你是希望我們為你做正義的打手還是私欲的保鑣？
english: Do you want us as justice's enforcers, or as bodyguards for your own grudge?

chinese: 我告訴你一段往事，也許可以釐清真像‧‧我的外表可以告訴你我們是屬於不同種族的人，我們奔龍族才是這個世
english: Let me tell you something from the past, it may make the truth clearer... You can see from my form that we are of different races. We Benlong people were the first inhabitants of this

chinese: 界最早的居民，在很久遠的時代，這個世界的空氣非常的稀薄，我們的生理結構只能承受這樣的環境‧‧
english: world. In the distant past the air of this world was very thin, and our bodies could only bear an environment like that...

chinese: 你是說這個世界後來又產生了變動？
english: You mean the world changed afterward?

chinese: 沒錯！我的祖先告訴下一代，下一代再告訴下一代，所以我才知道我的族人們所經歷的浩劫，當毀滅性的改變發生
english: Just so. My ancestors told the next generation, and they told the next, and that is how I know of the catastrophe my people lived through. When the destroying change came

chinese: 之後，有一部份的族人落入這個龐大又空氣稀薄的洞穴中，才未使奔龍族遭受滅種的命運‧‧
english: some of my people fell into this vast cavern with its thin air, and only so did the Benlong escape extinction...

chinese: 如果你是要我為你向大自然討回公道的話，我想你還是打消這個念頭吧！
english: If you want me to win you justice against nature itself, I think you had better give up the idea.

chinese: 讓我把話說完！當我的祖先來到這個與我們生存環境相仿的地方之後，族人們從未放棄回到地上的希望，這只是毫
english: Let me finish. Once my ancestors reached this place so like our old home, my people never gave up hope of returning to the surface. It was only hope

chinese: 無希望的希望，我們在這裡延續族群的生命，可是一個叫休斯的人類王子卻毀了奔龍族，當我死了也就是滅種之日。
english: without hope. We carried the race on down here, but a human prince called Sius destroyed the Benlong. The day I die is the day we die out.

chinese: 他是怎麼毀了奔龍族？你為什麼還活著？
english: How did he destroy the Benlong? And why are you still alive?

chinese: 你若是覺得此地空氣稀薄，你早已死於此！我的身體構造異於我的族人才能使我生存下來，修斯他在這附近炸山，
english: If the air here felt thin to you, you would already be dead. My body is built differently from my people's, and that is how I survive. Sius blasted the mountain near here,

chinese: 造成外面的空氣進入我們所居住的洞穴中，族人們無法適應，一個個的接連死去。
english: and the outside air poured into the cavern where we lived. My people could not adapt, and they died one after another.

chinese: 你怎麼能確定是他幹的？
english: How can you be sure it was him?

chinese: 族裡的巫師有顆靈驗的水晶球能測知發生過的事！我希望你能替我族人復仇！事成後我會送你最強的武器與防具。
english: Our tribe's shaman has a crystal ball that truly shows what has happened. I want you to avenge my people. When it is done I will give you the strongest weapon and armor.

chinese: 好！破壞大地之美的人沒有活著的價值。
english: Agreed. A man who destroys the beauty of the earth has no right to be alive.

chinese: 謝謝！
english: Thank you!

chinese: 我知道你還沒辦到，因為我有水晶球！
english: I know you have not done it yet, because I have the crystal ball.

chinese: 我知道你辦到了，因為我有水晶球！我為你打開本族的藏寶室，謝謝你為我族伸張正義！我的心願已了，從此可以平靜的渡過餘生！
english: I know you did it, because I have the crystal ball. I've opened our treasure room for you. Thank you for our justice. My wish is granted; I can live out my days in peace.

chinese: 願我的祖先賜福給你們！
english: May my ancestors bless you.

chinese: 對於你們的遭遇我寄予無限的同情，耐何我們人微力薄，恕難相助！
english: I feel deeply for what happened to you, but we are few and weak. Forgive us, we cannot help.

chinese: 我希望你們人類能愛護自己的生存環境，愛惜大自然，尊重每種動物的生存權利。
english: I hope you humans will care for the place you live in, treasure nature, and respect every animal's right to live.

chinese: 我會記住你沉重的呼喻！
english: I will remember your heavy plea.

chinese: 不要再來打擾我了！讓我靜靜的等待死亡。
english: Do not come and disturb me again. Let me wait quietly for death.

chinese: 這似乎是一種符號，也許我放入正確的物品就能觸動某些事情的發生！
english: This looks like some kind of symbol. Perhaps if I place the right item here, something will happen.

chinese: 歡迎來到蘇格禮，一座充滿藝術格調的小鎮！
english: Welcome to Sugeli, a little town full of artistic taste!

chinese: 本鎮的繪畫與木彫獨步全國！
english: Our painting and wood carving are the finest in the country.

chinese: 請你們尊重藝術創作者的心血結晶！
english: Please respect the work these artists have poured their hearts into.

chinese: 回答我誰為音樂付出性命？
english: Answer me this: who gave his life for music?

chinese: 是超脫合唱團！
english: Nirvana!

chinese: 是的！他們的主唱承受不了來的太快的成功，成功依舊無法填補空虛的心靈，他選擇自殺！超脫合唱團的CD送給你！
english: Yes. Their singer could not bear how fast success came, and success still could not fill the emptiness in him. He chose to end his life. Here, take the Nirvana CD.

chinese: 是分不清顏色的尖鼻子超級巨星麥克傑克森！
english: Michael Jackson, the pointy-nosed superstar who cannot tell one color from another!

chinese: 在我們這個時代他還沒出生，在某個時代他還活著。
english: In our age he has not been born yet. In some other age he is still alive.

chinese: 是紅的發紫的樂團小紅莓！
english: The Cranberries, the band everyone is mad about!

chinese: 在我們這個時代他還沒出生，在某個時代他還活著。
english: In our age he has not been born yet. In some other age he is still alive.

chinese: 我熱愛音樂！
english: I love music!

chinese: 我愛喝酒，酒給我創做的靈感！
english: I love a drink. Wine gives me my inspiration.

chinese: 敬發明酒的人一杯！
english: Here is to whoever invented wine!

chinese: 聽說有一夥匪類，來到本鎮大肆破壞，好像就是你們！賤貨‧‧我討厭你們！
english: I hear a pack of bandits came to this town and smashed the place up. That sounds like you. Filth... I hate the lot of you.

chinese: 我的天份驚人，腦子裡充滿了美麗的造型‧‧只是我已失失去雙臂，這個世上有一把曠世名刀：沁冰刻刀，我只要
english: My talent is astonishing, my head is full of beautiful shapes... only I have lost both my arms. There is one legendary blade in this world, the Chillfrost Carving Knife. If I only

chinese: 擁有它，我會鍛鍊自己用嘴去創作，你們願意幫助我尋找沁冰刻刀嗎？我會以九天乾坤做為謝禮。
english: had it, I would train myself to carve with my mouth. Will you help me find the Chillfrost Carving Knife? I will thank you with the Nine Heavens Cosmos.

chinese: 沒問題！
english: No problem!

chinese: 感激不盡！
english: I cannot thank you enough.

chinese: 還沒找到嗎？
english: Not found it yet?

chinese: 謝謝你！這是九天乾坤，聽說在奔龍遺蹟用的著！
english: Thank you! Here is the Nine Heavens Cosmos. I hear it is useful in the Benlong Ruins.

chinese: 我一直在苦練用嘴彫刻！
english: I have been training hard to carve with my mouth.

chinese: 若是有心，什麼三流工具都刻的出完美的作品！
english: If the will is there, even a third-rate tool can produce a perfect piece.

chinese: 一語驚醒夢中人！我會發奮圖強。
english: One sentence and I am wide awake. I will work harder than ever.

chinese: 你的鼓勵永難忘懷！
english: I will never forget your encouragement.

chinese: 我是阿里，一直窮困潦倒，我的作品得不到大家的賞識，藝術是主觀的，我不在乎！
english: I am Ali. I have always been poor and down on my luck, and nobody thinks much of my work. Art is a matter of taste. I do not care.

chinese: 我賣的溫熱手鐲是到冰寒大廳觀光必備之物，能防止身體遭受嚴重凍傷，一支一萬！
english: The warming bracelets I sell are essential for a visit to the Frozen Hall. They keep your body from severe frostbite. Ten thousand each.

chinese: 我買！
english: I will buy one!

chinese: 你在敲竹槓！
english: That is daylight robbery.

chinese: 聽說你能用約書亞樹枝做枯萎豎笛，我需要你的幫助！
english: I hear you can make a withering clarinet from a Joshua tree branch. I need your help.

chinese: 助人為快樂之本！
english: Helping others is the root of happiness.

chinese: 你並沒有約書亞樹枝。
english: You do not have a Joshua tree branch.

chinese: 不！我不會幫助對藝術不尊重的人！
english: No! I will not help anyone who has no respect for art.

chinese: 你們令人僧恨！
english: You people are hateful.

chinese: 我在礦坑中發現一隻金絲雀，牠看起來像烏鴉。我在竹籬笆外發現一朵牽牛花，它插在牛糞上。
english: I found a canary in the mine shaft, and it looked like a crow. I found a morning glory outside the bamboo fence, and it was planted in cow dung.

chinese: 人生如夢，有好的夢，有壞的夢，我從來不做夢！人生如戲，有精緻大戲，有低級爛戲，我從來不看戲！
english: Life is a dream, some good, some bad. I never dream. Life is a play, some fine, some cheap trash. I never watch plays.

chinese: 休斯王子前一陣子在奔龍遺蹟附近炸山取樂，他說：仁者樂山，智者樂水！
english: Prince Sius was blasting the mountain near the Benlong Ruins a while back, for fun. He said: the wise delight in water, the good delight in hills.

chinese: 階級制度有個好處，一些個愛慕虛榮自以為有幾分姿色的女子，再也不能飛上枝頭做鳳凰，所以我才能討到個如花似玉，美不勝收的老婆！
english: The class system has one benefit. Vain girls who think they are pretty can no longer marry up into the branches, and that is how I got a wife as lovely as a flower.

chinese: 這個國家雖然是富人愈富，窮人愈窮，我還是熱愛著這塊土地，它讓我種蕃薯種芭樂，娶得美嬌娘。
english: The rich get richer and the poor get poorer in this country, but I still love this land. It lets me grow sweet potatoes and guavas, and it got me a beautiful wife.

chinese: 我愛我的國家，希望國家也一樣的愛我！
english: I love my country. I hope my country loves me back.

chinese: 我有傾國傾城的容貌，卻只能每天吃蕃薯。
english: I have a face that could topple a kingdom, and all I get to eat is sweet potatoes.

chinese: 紅顏薄命！此話一點都不假‧‧
english: Beauty always meets a hard fate. There is not a word of a lie in that...

chinese: 是否要休息？
english: Rest here?

chinese: 我是寫實派大師曹小安，我的雕刻有高難度高感度高技巧大手筆及最會被對面自稱抽象派領袖莊小俊抹黑的傑作。
english: I'm Cao Xiao'an, master of realism. My carvings are hard, expressive, skilled and grand, and most smeared by Zhuang Xiaojun across the way, self-styled leader of abstraction.

chinese: 我要給他死我要放火燒他的厝我要‧我要‧他再也不能一柱擎天，這麼富有高貴情操的手段需要你來完成，好嗎？
english: I want him dead. I want to burn his house down. I want... I want him never to stand up straight again. This noble and high-minded plan needs you to carry it out. Will you?

chinese: 好！不過真的要這麼殘忍嗎？
english: All right. But does it really have to be that cruel?

chinese: 我說的只是氣話，毀掉他的狗屁看不懂的畫就好了，事成後送你神奇功效增強能力的美酒一瓶，有效噢！
english: I was only talking in anger. Just destroy those useless paintings nobody can make sense of. When it's done I'll give you a bottle of fine wine that boosts your powers. It works!

chinese: 這個條件不錯！
english: Those are decent terms.

chinese: 毀掉他的狗屁看不懂的畫了嗎？
english: Have you destroyed those useless paintings nobody can make sense of?

chinese: 你搞定了，所以你得到了！
english: You handled it, so you have earned it.

chinese: 謝謝你幫我出了一口氣！
english: Thank you for getting that off my chest.

chinese: 不行！
english: I cannot do it.

chinese: 算了！
english: Forget it then.

chinese: 你不是不行嗎？不行要去找阿舉師，來找我幹嘛！
english: So you cannot do it? If you cannot do it, go see Master Aju. Why come to me?

chinese: 是否要破壞此雕像！
english: Destroy this statue?

chinese: 我是抽象派領袖莊小俊，我的畫風有意境有美感有正確的人生觀及最會被對面自稱寫實派大師曹小安幹譙的傑作。
english: I'm Zhuang Xiaojun, leader of abstraction. My paintings have depth, beauty and a sound view of life, and most cursed by Cao Xiao'an across the way, self-styled master of realism.

chinese: 我要他放棄懶覺砍斷他的雙手別想再雕刻別想再賴床！這麼富有高貴情操的手段需要你來完成‧好嗎？
english: I want him to give up his lazing. Cut off both his hands so he can never carve again and never lie in bed again! This noble, high-minded plan needs you to carry it out. Will you?

chinese: 好！不過真的要這麼殘忍嗎？
english: All right. But does it really have to be that cruel?

chinese: 我說的只是氣話，毀掉他的狗屁看不懂的破雕像就好了，事成後送你中間婁空可套在香蕉上的象牙一支，保證你用過之後對方說讚！
english: I was only talking in anger. Just destroy those useless carvings nobody can make sense of. When it's done I'll give you a hollow ivory tube that fits over a banana. Guaranteed praise.

chinese: 這個條件不錯！
english: Those are decent terms.

chinese: 毀掉他的狗屁爛雕像了嗎？
english: Have you destroyed those useless carvings of his?

chinese: 你辦到了，所以你得到了！
english: You did it, so you have earned it.

chinese: 謝謝你幫我出了一口氣！
english: Thank you for getting that off my chest.

chinese: 不行！
english: I cannot do it.

chinese: 算了！
english: Forget it then.

chinese: 你不是不行嗎？不行要去找阿起師，來找我幹嘛！
english: So you cannot do it? If you cannot do it, go see Master Aqi. Why come to me?

chinese: 是否要破壞此圖畫！
english: Destroy this painting?
